from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# Separate features, target, ids
X = train.drop(columns=["id", "target"])
y = train["target"]
test_ids = test["id"]
X_test = test.drop(columns=["id"])

# Define categorical feature names (columns that are object or low-cardinality integers)
cat_features = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)] + [  # f_07 - f_18
    "f_27",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]

# Ensure all categorical columns are of string type (CatBoost handles int categorical as numeric unless specified)
for col in cat_features:
    X[col] = X[col].astype(str)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype(str)

# 5-fold cross-validation
n_folds = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
auc_scores = []
best_iters = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train_fold, X_val_fold = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_train_fold, y_val_fold = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

    # CatBoost model with GPU
    model = CatBoostClassifier(
        task_type="GPU",
        devices="0",
        iterations=2000,
        learning_rate=0.03,
        depth=6,
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        random_seed=42,
        verbose=0,
        allow_writing_files=False,
        cat_features=cat_features,
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train_fold,
        y_train_fold,
        eval_set=(X_val_fold, y_val_fold),
        use_best_model=True,
    )

    # Validation predictions
    preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_fold)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_fold, preds)
    auc_scores.append(auc)
    best_iters.append(model.get_best_iteration())
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {auc:.6f}")

# Mean cross-validation AUC
mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Mean CV AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Use average best iteration for final training
avg_best_iter = int(np.ceil(np.mean(best_iters)))

# Train final model on full training set
final_model = CatBoostClassifier(
    task_type="GPU",
    devices="0",
    iterations=avg_best_iter,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    depth=6,
    random_seed=42,
    verbose=0,
    allow_writing_files=False,
    cat_features=cat_features,
)
final_model.fit(X, y)

# Predict on test set
test_preds = final_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_preds})

print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_auc:.6f}")

cat_cols = cat_cols_low + cat_cols_high

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.  Factorise categorical features (train + test to handle unseen values)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
cat_info_dict = {}

# high‑cardinality string column
combined_f27 = pd.concat([train["f_27"], test["f_27"]], axis=0)
codes_27, uniques_27 = pd.factorize(combined_f27)
train["f_27_code"] = codes_27[: len(train)]
test["f_27_code"] = codes_27[len(train) :]
cat_info_dict["f_27"] = len(uniques_27)

# low‑cardinality integer columns
for col in cat_cols_low:
    combined = pd.concat([train[col], test[col]], axis=0)
    codes, uniques = pd.factorize(combined)
    train[col + "_code"] = codes[: len(train)]
    test[col + "_code"] = codes[len(train) :]
    cat_info_dict[col] = len(uniques)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.  Embedding sizes (drastic reduction for speed)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
embedding_sizes = []
for col in cat_cols:
    n_cats = cat_info_dict[col]
    # All categories use dimension 2 to keep the model lightning fast
    emb_dim = 2
    embedding_sizes.append((n_cats, emb_dim))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.  Prepare numeric & categorical arrays
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
numeric_train = train[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
cat_train = train[[col + "_code" for col in cat_cols]].values.astype(np.int64)
target = train["target"].values.astype(np.float32)

numeric_test = test[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
cat_test = test[[col + "_code" for col in cat_cols]].values.astype(np.int64)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.  Model definition (smaller hidden layers)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
class TabularNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric, embedding_sizes, hidden_layers, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(num_cats, emb_dim) for num_cats, emb_dim in embedding_sizes]
        )
        total_emb_dim = sum(emb_dim for _, emb_dim in embedding_sizes)
        input_dim = num_numeric + total_emb_dim

        layers = []
        prev_dim = input_dim
        for hidden in hidden_layers:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden))
            layers.append(nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            prev_dim = hidden
        layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, 1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, numeric, cat_indices):
        embs = []
        for i, emb_layer in enumerate(self.embeddings):
            embs.append(emb_layer(cat_indices[:, i]))
        emb_concat = torch.cat(embs, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([numeric, emb_concat], dim=1)
        out = self.net(x)
        return self.sigmoid(out).squeeze(1)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.  Training function for one fold
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def train_one_fold(
    train_num,
    train_cat,
    train_y,
    val_num,
    val_cat,
    val_y,
    embedding_sizes,
    num_numeric,
    hidden_layers,
    dropout,
    lr,
    weight_decay,
    batch_size,
    max_epochs,
    patience,
):
    model = TabularNN(num_numeric, embedding_sizes, hidden_layers, dropout).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=weight_decay)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    # Scale numeric within fold
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaler.fit(train_num)
    train_num_sc = scaler.transform(train_num)
    val_num_sc = scaler.transform(val_num)

    # DataLoaders
    train_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(train_num_sc, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(train_cat, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(train_y, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    val_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(val_num_sc, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(val_cat, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(val_y, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=0
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

    best_auc = -1
    best_epoch = 0
    patience_counter = 0
    best_state = model.state_dict()

    for epoch in range(1, max_epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        for bn, bc, by in train_loader:
            bn, bc, by = bn.to(device), bc.to(device), by.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            preds = model(bn, bc)
            loss = criterion(preds, by)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

        # Validation AUC
        model.eval()
        val_preds = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for bn, bc, _ in val_loader:
                bn, bc = bn.to(device), bc.to(device)
                val_preds.append(model(bn, bc).cpu().numpy())
        val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
        auc = roc_auc_score(val_y, val_preds)

        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            best_state = model.state_dict()
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= patience:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    return best_auc, best_epoch, model, scaler


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.  5‑fold cross‑validation (reduced epochs)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_aucs, best_epochs = [], []

hidden_layers = [64, 32]  # smaller head
dropout = 0.2
lr = 1e-3
weight_decay = 1e-5
batch_size = 16384
max_epochs = 15  # drastically reduced
patience = 3  # stop earlier
num_numeric = len(num_cols)

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(numeric_train, target)):
    print(f"Fold {fold+1}...")
    X_num_tr, X_cat_tr, y_tr = numeric_train[tr_idx], cat_train[tr_idx], target[tr_idx]
    X_num_val, X_cat_val, y_val = (
        numeric_train[val_idx],
        cat_train[val_idx],
        target[val_idx],
    )

    auc, ep, _, _ = train_one_fold(
        X_num_tr,
        X_cat_tr,
        y_tr,
        X_num_val,
        X_cat_val,
        y_val,
        embedding_sizes,
        num_numeric,
        hidden_layers,
        dropout,
        lr,
        weight_decay,
        batch_size,
        max_epochs,
        patience,
    )
    cv_aucs.append(auc)
    best_epochs.append(ep)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {auc:.6f}  best epoch: {ep}")

mean_cv_auc = np.mean(cv_aucs)
avg_epochs = int(round(np.mean(best_epochs)))
print(f"CV Mean AUC: {mean_cv_auc:.6f}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.  Final training on full train set
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
scaler_full = StandardScaler()
scaler_full.fit(numeric_train)
X_num_full = scaler_full.transform(numeric_train)

full_ds = TensorDataset(
    torch.tensor(X_num_full, dtype=torch.float32),
    torch.tensor(cat_train, dtype=torch.long),
    torch.tensor(target, dtype=torch.float32),
)
full_loader = DataLoader(full_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=0)

model_final = TabularNN(num_numeric, embedding_sizes, hidden_layers, dropout).to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model_final.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=weight_decay)
criterion = nn.BCELoss()

for epoch in range(1, avg_epochs + 1):

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        preds = model_final(bn, bc)
        loss = criterion(preds, by)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.  Predict on test set and create submission
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
test_num_sc = scaler_full.transform(numeric_test)
test_ds = TensorDataset(
    torch.tensor(test_num_sc, dtype=torch.float32),
    torch.tensor(cat_test, dtype=torch.long),
)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

model_final.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for bn, bc in test_loader:
        bn, bc = bn.to(device), bc.to(device)
        test_preds.append(model_final(bn, bc).cpu().numpy())
test_preds = np.concatenate(test_preds)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "target": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

            lgb_val,
            label=y_val,
            categorical_feature=lgb_cat_features,
            reference=dtrain,
            free_raw_data=False,
        )

        # CatBoost data
        cb_tr = cb_X_full.iloc[tr_idx]

    print(f"CatBoost best iters: {cb_best_iters} (mean {np.mean(cb_best_iters):.0f})")

    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]
high_card_col = "f_27"
cat_cols_all = cat_cols_low + [high_card_col]

# Numeric columns (everything that is not in cat_cols_all)
num_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in cat_cols_all]

# ----------------------------- 2. Frequency / count encoding -----------------------------
freq_maps = {}
train_len = len(train)
for col in cat_cols_all:
    freq_maps[f"{col}_count"] = train[col].value_counts()
    freq_maps[f"{col}_freq"] = train[col].value_counts(normalize=True)


def add_freq_features(df, train_len, train_mode=True):
    for col in cat_cols_all:
        df[f"{col}_count"] = (
            df[col].map(freq_maps[f"{col}_count"]).fillna(1).astype(int)
        )
        df[f"{col}_freq"] = (
            df[col].map(freq_maps[f"{col}_freq"]).fillna(1 / train_len).astype(float)
        )
    # Label-encode f_27 for tree models that cannot handle raw strings
    if train_mode:
        codes, uniques = pd.factorize(df[high_card_col])
    else:
        # Map using training codes; unseen become -1
        _, uniques = pd.factorize(train[high_card_col])
        codes = (
            pd.Series(df[high_card_col])
            .map({val: idx for idx, val in enumerate(uniques)})
            .fillna(-1)
            .astype(int)
            .values
        )
    df[f"{high_card_col}_le"] = codes
    return df


train = add_freq_features(train, train_len, train_mode=True)
test = add_freq_features(test, train_len, train_mode=False)

# ----------------------------- 3. Prepare feature matrices -----------------------------

import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

target_col = "target"

    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
    "f_27",
]
te_cols = [f"{c}_te" for c in cat_cols]
count_col = ["f_27_count"]  # only for f_27

# Create working copies
train_df = train.copy()
test_df = test.copy()

# ---------- 2. Prepare columns for encoded features ----------
for col in te_cols:
    train_df[col] = np.nan
    test_df[col] = np.nan
train_df[count_col[0]] = np.nan
test_df[count_col[0]] = np.nan

# Global statistics (used for test set and final models)
global_target_mean = train[target_col].mean()
global_counts = train_df["f_27"].value_counts()
global_te = {c: train.groupby(c)[target_col].mean() for c in cat_cols}

# ---------- 3. Out-of-fold encoding (5-fold CV) ----------
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
fold_indices = list(skf.split(train_df, train_df[target_col]))

# Assign fold for per-row encoding
train_df["fold"] = -1
for fold_idx, (_, val_idx) in enumerate(fold_indices):
    train_df.loc[val_idx, "fold"] = fold_idx

for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(fold_indices):
    train_fold = train_df.iloc[train_idx]
    # target encoding for every categorical column
    for c in cat_cols:
        means = train_fold.groupby(c)[target_col].mean()
        train_df.loc[val_idx, f"{c}_te"] = train_df.loc[val_idx, c].map(means)
    # count encoding for f_27
    counts = train_fold["f_27"].value_counts()
    train_df.loc[val_idx, "f_27_count"] = train_df.loc[val_idx, "f_27"].map(counts)

# Fill missing values (categories unseen in training folds) with global stats

    for col in cat_cols_all:

        train.loc[val_idx, col + "_te"] = train.loc[val_idx, col].map(mapping)

for col in cat_cols_all:

    + [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]
    + ["f_28"]
)  # 15 pure numerics

n_splits = 5
random_state = 42

    # Fix: fill NaN std values caused by groups with a single observation
    train[f"{col}_std_f27"] = grp.transform("std").fillna(train[col].std())
    mean_map = grp.mean()
    test[f"{col}_mean_f27"] = test["f_27"].map(mean_map).fillna(train[col].mean())
    std_map = grp.std()
    test[f"{col}_std_f27"] = test["f_27"].map(std_map).fillna(train[col].std())

# Count per f_27
cnt_map = train.groupby("f_27").size()
train["f_27_cnt"] = train["f_27"].map(cnt_map)
test["f_27_cnt"] = test["f_27"].map(cnt_map).fillna(cnt_map.median())  # median is safe

    global_t_mean = train[target_col].mean()  # fill for unseen categories

import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
import lightgbm as lgb

# ----------------------------- DATA LOADING -----------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

X_train = train.drop(columns=["id", "target"])
y_train = train["target"]
id_test = test["id"]
X_test = test.drop(columns=["id"])

# ----------------------------- PREPROCESSING -----------------------------
# 1. Encode f_27 (object -> integer) by factorizing the union of train+test strings
all_f27 = pd.concat([X_train["f_27"], X_test["f_27"]], axis=0).astype(str)
codes, _ = pd.factorize(all_f27, sort=False)
X_train["f_27"] = codes[: len(X_train)]
X_test["f_27"] = codes[len(X_train) :]

# 2. Categorical columns (all low-cardinality except f_27 which we'll treat as numeric)
cat_cols_all = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
    "f_27",  # keep in the data but NOT as a categorical feature for LightGBM
]
# Convert them to int for consistency
for c in cat_cols_all:
    X_train[c] = X_train[c].astype(int)
    X_test[c] = X_test[c].astype(int)

# 3. Continuous columns for polynomial expansion
numeric_cols = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]

# Polynomial features (degree 2, include bias=False) on continuous columns only
numeric_train = X_train[numeric_cols].values
numeric_test = X_test[numeric_cols].values
numeric_all = np.vstack([numeric_train, numeric_test])

poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=False, interaction_only=False)
poly.fit(numeric_all)

poly_train = poly.transform(numeric_train)
poly_test = poly.transform(numeric_test)

poly_feature_names = poly.get_feature_names_out(numeric_cols)
df_poly_train = pd.DataFrame(poly_train, columns=poly_feature_names)
df_poly_test = pd.DataFrame(poly_test, columns=poly_feature_names)

# 4. Build final feature set: polynomial features + ALL integer columns (including f_27)
X_train_processed = pd.concat(
    [
        df_poly_train.reset_index(drop=True),
        X_train[cat_cols_all].reset_index(drop=True),
    ],
    axis=1,
)
X_test_processed = pd.concat(
    [df_poly_test.reset_index(drop=True), X_test[cat_cols_all].reset_index(drop=True)],
    axis=1,
)

# 5. Categorical features for LightGBM: all low-cardinality categoricals EXCEPT f_27
cat_features_lgb = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]
cat_features_idx = [X_train_processed.columns.get_loc(c) for c in cat_features_lgb]

# ----------------------------- LIGHTGBM SETUP -----------------------------
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 128,  # reduced from 256 for speed
    "learning_rate": 0.02,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "lambda_l1": 0.1,
    "lambda_l2": 1.0,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 100,
    "max_cat_threshold": 1000000,  # high enough for the low‑cardinality features
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Use LightGBM's built-in early stopping and logging callbacks
callbacks = [lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=200)]

# ----------------------------- 5-FOLD CV -----------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
oof_preds = np.zeros(len(y_train))
test_preds = np.zeros(len(id_test))

print("Starting 5-fold cross-validation...")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train_processed, y_train)):
    print(f"--- Fold {fold+1} ---")
    X_tr = X_train_processed.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val = X_train_processed.iloc[val_idx]
    y_tr = y_train.iloc[train_idx]
    y_val = y_train.iloc[val_idx]

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_features_idx)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature=cat_features_idx)

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=1000,  # reduced from 2000
        valid_sets=[dtrain, dval],
        valid_names=["train", "valid"],
        callbacks=callbacks,
    )

    # Predictions on validation and test
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    oof_preds[val_idx] = val_pred
    test_preds += (
        model.predict(X_test_processed, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
        / skf.n_splits
    )

# ----------------------------- EVALUATION -----------------------------
cv_auc = roc_auc_score(y_train, oof_preds)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_auc:.6f}")

# ----------------------------- SUBMISSION -----------------------------
sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": id_test, "target": test_preds})
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print("submission.csv saved.")

import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import time
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ----------------------------- load data -----------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
print(f"Train: {train.shape}, Test: {test.shape}")

# target
y = train["target"]
train_id = train["id"]
test_id = test["id"]
target_col = "target"

# ----------------------------- continuous and discrete features -----------------------------
cont_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7)]  # f_00..f_06
cont_cols += [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]  # f_19..f_26
cont_cols += ["f_28"]

# discrete integer features (we treat as numeric)
disc_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)]  # f_07..f_18

# low-cardinality categorical features (will be passed as categorical to LightGBM)
cat_cols = ["f_29", "f_30"]

# high-cardinality categorical feature
high_card_col = "f_27"


# ----------------------------- pair-wise interactions (continuous) -----------------------------
def add_interactions(df):
    for i in range(len(cont_cols)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(cont_cols)):
            col_name = f"inter_{cont_cols[i]}_{cont_cols[j]}"
            df[col_name] = df[cont_cols[i]] * df[cont_cols[j]]


# add interactions to train and test (they are fast)
add_interactions(train)
add_interactions(test)

# keep a list of all feature columns except id and target
feature_cols = cont_cols + disc_cols + cat_cols + [high_card_col]
interaction_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith("inter_")]
feature_cols += interaction_cols


# ----------------------------- encoding functions -----------------------------
def frequency_encode(train_df, valid_df, test_df, col, global_train_df=None):
    """
    Frequency encoding using training data (or global_train_df for test).
    For unseen categories in valid/test, assign frequency=1.
    """
    if global_train_df is None:
        freq = train_df[col].value_counts()
    else:
        freq = global_train_df[col].value_counts()
    train_df[col + "_freq"] = train_df[col].map(freq).fillna(1).astype(np.int32)
    valid_df[col + "_freq"] = valid_df[col].map(freq).fillna(1).astype(np.int32)
    if test_df is not None:
        test_df[col + "_freq"] = test_df[col].map(freq).fillna(1).astype(np.int32)


def target_encode(
    train_df, valid_df, col, target_series, smoothing=10, global_mean=None
):
    """
    Smoothed target encoding. Returns dict mapping category -> encoded value.
    Used for fold-specific encoding; for test we'll use full train encoding.
    """
    if global_mean is None:
        global_mean = target_series.mean()
    agg = train_df.groupby(col)[target_series.name].agg(["mean", "count"])
    counts = agg["count"]
    means = agg["mean"]
    smoothed = (counts * means + smoothing * global_mean) / (counts + smoothing)
    mapping = smoothed.to_dict()
    train_df[col + "_te"] = train_df[col].map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)
    valid_df[col + "_te"] = valid_df[col].map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)
    return mapping


# ----------------------------- prepare test features (full train encoding) -----------------------------
# We need a copy of train for full encoding
train_copy = train.copy()
test_copy = test.copy()

# Full train frequency encoding on f_27
frequency_encode(train_copy, test_copy, None, high_card_col, global_train_df=train_copy)
# Full train target encoding on f_27
full_global_mean = y.mean()
full_te_mapping = target_encode(
    train_copy, test_copy, high_card_col, y, smoothing=10, global_mean=full_global_mean
)

# test feature set (fixed across folds)
test_feature_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c != high_card_col] + [
    high_card_col + "_freq",
    high_card_col + "_te",
]
X_test = test_copy[test_feature_cols].copy()

# ----------------------------- 5-fold CV -----------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
auc_scores = []
test_preds = np.zeros(len(test))
fold = 0

# LightGBM params (sensible fixed values)
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 64,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 1,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": 6,
    "seed": 42,
}

for train_idx, valid_idx in skf.split(train, y):
    fold += 1
    X_tr = train.iloc[train_idx].copy()
    X_val = train.iloc[valid_idx].copy()
    y_tr = y.iloc[train_idx].values
    y_val = y.iloc[valid_idx].values

    # ---- fold-specific encoding for f_27 ----
    # Frequency encoding (using current training fold)
    frequency_encode(X_tr, X_val, None, high_card_col)

    # Target encoding (using current training fold)
    fold_global_mean = y_tr.mean()
    target_encode(
        X_tr,
        X_val,
        high_card_col,
        pd.Series(y_tr, name="target"),
        smoothing=10,
        global_mean=fold_global_mean,
    )

    # Feature set without raw f_27 (we use the encoded versions)
    fold_feature_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c != high_card_col] + [
        high_card_col + "_freq",
        high_card_col + "_te",
    ]

    # ---- LightGBM datasets ----
    # categorical columns: f_29, f_30 (already converted to 'category' dtype)
    # In X_tr, they are still int; we can cast to category to let LightGBM handle them.
    for c in cat_cols:
        X_tr[c] = X_tr[c].astype("category")
        X_val[c] = X_val[c].astype("category")

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(
        X_tr[fold_feature_cols],
        label=y_tr,
        categorical_feature=cat_cols,
        free_raw_data=False,
    )
    dvalid = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val[fold_feature_cols],
        label=y_val,
        categorical_feature=cat_cols,
        reference=dtrain,
        free_raw_data=False,
    )

    # ---- training ----
    callbacks = [lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)]
    model = lgb.train(
        lgb_params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=5000,
        valid_sets=[dvalid],
        callbacks=callbacks,
    )

    # ---- validate ----
    val_pred = model.predict(
        X_val[fold_feature_cols], num_iteration=model.best_iteration
    )
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
    auc_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"Fold {fold} AUC: {auc:.6f}")

    # ---- test prediction (using the fixed test features) ----
    # Ensure categorical columns are category in X_test
    X_test_copy = X_test.copy()
    for c in cat_cols:
        X_test_copy[c] = X_test_copy[c].astype("category")
    test_preds += model.predict(
        X_test_copy[fold_feature_cols], num_iteration=model.best_iteration
    )

# average test predictions
test_preds /= 5.0
mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Mean CV AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# ----------------------------- save submission -----------------------------
sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_id, "target": test_preds})
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ========== 1. Load data ==========
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")

target_col = "target"
id_col = "id"

y = train[target_col].values
test_ids = test[id_col].values

# ========== 2. Define feature groups ==========
cont_feats = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]

low_card_cats = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]

high_card_cat = "f_27"

# ========== 3. Preprocess low-cardinality categoricals ==========
# LightGBM: keep original integer columns (no LabelEncoder needed)
# XGBoost: OneHotEncoder fitted on combined train+test low-cardinality cats (converted to string)
ohe = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False, handle_unknown="ignore")
combined_low = pd.concat(
    [train[low_card_cats].astype(str), test[low_card_cats].astype(str)], axis=0
)
ohe.fit(combined_low)
train_ohe = ohe.transform(train[low_card_cats].astype(str))
test_ohe = ohe.transform(test[low_card_cats].astype(str))
ohe_feat_names = [
    f"{col}_{cat}" for col, cats in zip(low_card_cats, ohe.categories_) for cat in cats
]
train_ohe_df = pd.DataFrame(train_ohe, columns=ohe_feat_names, index=train.index)
test_ohe_df = pd.DataFrame(test_ohe, columns=ohe_feat_names, index=test.index)

# XGBoost base: continuous + OHE (f_27 will be target-encoded later)
xgb_base_train = pd.concat([train[cont_feats], train_ohe_df], axis=1)
xgb_base_test = pd.concat([test[cont_feats], test_ohe_df], axis=1)

# LightGBM base: continuous + low_card_cats (as integers) + later f_27_te
lgb_base_train = train[cont_feats + low_card_cats].copy()
lgb_base_test = test[cont_feats + low_card_cats].copy()

# ========== 4. Cross-validation setup ==========
N_SPLITS = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

lgb_oof = np.zeros(len(train))
xgb_oof = np.zeros(len(train))
lgb_test_preds = np.zeros(len(test))
xgb_test_preds = np.zeros(len(test))

# ========== 5. CV loop ==========
for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train, y)):
    print(f"Fold {fold+1}/{N_SPLITS} ...")

    # ----- Target encode f_27 on training fold (for both models) -----
    train_f27 = train[high_card_cat].iloc[tr_idx]
    val_f27 = train[high_card_cat].iloc[val_idx]
    test_f27 = test[high_card_cat]

    # Compute smoothed target probability per category on training fold
    cat_target = pd.DataFrame({"cat": train_f27, "target": y[tr_idx]})
    stats = cat_target.groupby("cat")["target"].agg(["mean", "count"])
    global_mean = y[tr_idx].mean()
    smoothing = 10
    stats["smoothed"] = (stats["count"] * stats["mean"] + global_mean * smoothing) / (
        stats["count"] + smoothing
    )
    te_map = stats["smoothed"].to_dict()

    tr_f27_te = train_f27.map(te_map).fillna(global_mean)
    val_f27_te = val_f27.map(te_map).fillna(global_mean)
    test_f27_te = test_f27.map(te_map).fillna(global_mean)

    # ----- LightGBM -----
    lgb_tr = lgb_base_train.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    lgb_val = lgb_base_train.iloc[val_idx].copy()
    lgb_te = lgb_base_test.copy()

    # Add target-encoded f_27 as numeric feature
    lgb_tr["f_27_te"] = tr_f27_te.values
    lgb_val["f_27_te"] = val_f27_te.values
    lgb_te["f_27_te"] = test_f27_te.values

    lgb_train_ds = lgb.Dataset(
        lgb_tr, label=y[tr_idx], categorical_feature=low_card_cats
    )
    lgb_val_ds = lgb.Dataset(
        lgb_val,
        label=y[val_idx],
        categorical_feature=low_card_cats,
        reference=lgb_train_ds,
    )

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 255,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
        "random_state": 42,
    }

    callbacks = [lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)]
    lgb_model = lgb.train(
        lgb_params,
        lgb_train_ds,
        num_boost_round=2000,
        valid_sets=[lgb_val_ds],
        valid_names=["valid"],
        callbacks=callbacks,
    )
    best_iter = lgb_model.best_iteration

    lgb_oof[val_idx] = lgb_model.predict(lgb_val, num_iteration=best_iter)
    lgb_test_preds += lgb_model.predict(lgb_te, num_iteration=best_iter) / N_SPLITS

    # ----- XGBoost -----
    xgb_tr = xgb_base_train.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    xgb_val = xgb_base_train.iloc[val_idx].copy()
    xgb_te = xgb_base_test.copy()

    xgb_tr["f_27_te"] = tr_f27_te.values
    xgb_val["f_27_te"] = val_f27_te.values
    xgb_te["f_27_te"] = test_f27_te.values

    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(xgb_tr, label=y[tr_idx])
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(xgb_val, label=y[val_idx])

    xgb_params = {
        "objective": "binary:logistic",
        "eval_metric": "auc",
        "max_depth": 6,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "tree_method": "hist",  # CPU histogram
        "random_state": 42,
        "verbosity": 0,
    }

    xgb_model = xgb.train(
        xgb_params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=2000,
        evals=[(dval, "valid")],
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )
    best_iter_xgb = xgb_model.best_iteration + 1  # number of trees

    # Use iteration_range (0, best_iter_xgb) which is equivalent to the previous ntree_limit
    xgb_oof[val_idx] = xgb_model.predict(
        xgb.DMatrix(xgb_val), iteration_range=(0, best_iter_xgb)
    )
    xgb_test_preds += (
        xgb_model.predict(xgb.DMatrix(xgb_te), iteration_range=(0, best_iter_xgb))
        / N_SPLITS
    )

# ========== 6. Compute ensemble OOF score ==========
ensemble_oof = (lgb_oof + xgb_oof) / 2.0
final_auc = roc_auc_score(y, ensemble_oof)

# ========== 7. Save submission ==========
ensemble_test = (lgb_test_preds + xgb_test_preds) / 2.0
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": ensemble_test})
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {final_auc:.6f}")

import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================
# 1. Data loading
# ============================
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
sub = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")

y = train["target"].values.astype(np.float32)
train_X = train.drop(columns=["target", "id"])
test_X = test.drop(columns=["id"])

# ---- Fix: continuous columns without f_27 (it is an object column) ----
cont_cols = (
    [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(0, 7)]
    + [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]
    + ["f_28"]
)  # 7 + 8 + 1 = 16 numeric floats
int_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)] + [
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]  # 12 + 2 = 14 numeric ints
cat_col = "f_27"

num_folds = 5
kf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=num_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

BATCH_SIZE = 4096
MAX_EPOCHS = 30
LR = 1e-3
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4
PATIENCE = 5

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


# ============================
# 2. Helper: smoothed target encoding
# ============================
def smoothed_target_encode(s, y, global_mean, alpha=5.0):
    """Return mapping from category -> smoothed target mean."""
    stats = pd.DataFrame({"target": y, "cat": s})
    grouped = stats.groupby("cat")["target"].agg(["mean", "count"])
    grouped["smoothed"] = (grouped["mean"] * grouped["count"] + global_mean * alpha) / (
        grouped["count"] + alpha
    )
    return grouped["smoothed"].to_dict()


# ============================
# 3. Cross-validation loop
# ============================
val_aucs = []
test_preds = np.zeros(len(test_X), dtype=np.float32)

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(train_X, y)):
    print(f"=== Fold {fold+1}/{num_folds} ===")
    X_tr = train_X.iloc[train_idx].copy()
    X_val = train_X.iloc[val_idx].copy()
    y_tr = y[train_idx]
    y_val = y[val_idx]

    # ---- Target encoding for f_27 (with smoothing) ----
    global_mean = y_tr.mean()
    te_map = smoothed_target_encode(X_tr[cat_col], y_tr, global_mean, alpha=5.0)
    freq_map = X_tr[cat_col].value_counts().to_dict()

    # Apply to train/val/test
    X_tr["f27_te"] = X_tr[cat_col].map(te_map).fillna(global_mean)
    X_val["f27_te"] = X_val[cat_col].map(te_map).fillna(global_mean)
    test_te = test_X[cat_col].map(te_map).fillna(global_mean).astype(np.float32)

    X_tr["f27_freq"] = X_tr[cat_col].map(freq_map).fillna(0)
    X_val["f27_freq"] = X_val[cat_col].map(freq_map).fillna(0)
    test_freq = test_X[cat_col].map(freq_map).fillna(0).astype(np.float32)

    X_tr.drop(columns=[cat_col], inplace=True)
    X_val.drop(columns=[cat_col], inplace=True)

    # ---- Build final numeric feature set ----
    numeric_cols = cont_cols + int_cols + ["f27_te", "f27_freq"]
    X_tr = X_tr[numeric_cols].astype(np.float32)
    X_val = X_val[numeric_cols].astype(np.float32)
    test_fold = test_X[cont_cols + int_cols].copy()
    test_fold["f27_te"] = test_te
    test_fold["f27_freq"] = test_freq
    test_fold = test_fold[numeric_cols].astype(np.float32)

    # ---- Scaling ----
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_tr_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr)
    X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
    test_scaled = scaler.transform(test_fold)

    # ---- PyTorch datasets ----
    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.tensor(X_tr_scaled), torch.tensor(y_tr))
    val_ds = TensorDataset(torch.tensor(X_val_scaled), torch.tensor(y_val))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # ---- Model ----
    inp_dim = X_tr_scaled.shape[1]
    model = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(inp_dim, 256),
        nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Dropout(0.2),
        nn.Linear(256, 128),
        nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Dropout(0.2),
        nn.Linear(128, 64),
        nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Dropout(0.2),
        nn.Linear(64, 1),
    ).to(device)

    pos_cnt = y_tr.sum()
    neg_cnt = len(y_tr) - pos_cnt
    pos_weight = torch.tensor([neg_cnt / pos_cnt]).to(device) if pos_cnt > 0 else None

    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weight)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
        optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2
    )

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(MAX_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        for bx, by in train_loader:
            bx, by = bx.to(device), by.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(bx).squeeze(1)
            loss = criterion(logits, by)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(bx)
        train_loss = total_loss / len(train_ds)

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for bx, by in val_loader:
                bx, by = bx.to(device), by.to(device)
                logits = model(bx).squeeze(1)
                loss = criterion(logits, by)
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(bx)
        val_loss = val_loss / len(val_ds)

        scheduler.step(val_loss)

        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_state = {k: v.cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
            epochs_no_improve = 0
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1

        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"  Early stop at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    model.eval()

    # ---- Validation AUC ----
    with torch.no_grad():
        val_proba = (
            torch.sigmoid(model(torch.tensor(X_val_scaled).to(device)).squeeze(1))
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_proba)
    val_aucs.append(auc)
    print(f"  Fold AUC: {auc:.6f}")

    # ---- Test predictions ----
    with torch.no_grad():
        fold_test_pred = (
            torch.sigmoid(model(torch.tensor(test_scaled).to(device)).squeeze(1))
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
    test_preds += fold_test_pred / num_folds

# ============================
# 4. Final output
# ============================
mean_auc = np.mean(val_aucs)
std_auc = np.std(val_aucs)
print(f"CV AUC: {mean_auc:.6f} +/- {std_auc:.6f}")
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_auc:.6f}")

sub["target"] = test_preds.astype(np.float64)
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
import lightgbm as lgb

# ----------------------------- DATA LOADING -----------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# Separate target and IDs
y_train_full = train["target"]
id_test = test["id"]
train.drop(columns=["id", "target"], inplace=True)
test.drop(columns=["id"], inplace=True)

# ----------------------------- DEFINE COLUMNS -----------------------------
continuous_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7)]  # f_00 - f_06
continuous_cols += [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]  # f_19 - f_26
continuous_cols += ["f_28"]

cat_cols_low = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]
f27_col = "f_27"

# Ensure low-cardinality categoricals are int
for c in cat_cols_low:
    train[c] = train[c].astype(int)
    test[c] = test[c].astype(int)

# ----------------------------- FACTORIZE f_27 -----------------------------
all_f27 = pd.concat([train[f27_col], test[f27_col]], axis=0).astype(str)
codes, uniques = pd.factorize(all_f27, sort=False)
train["f27_code"] = codes[: len(train)]
test["f27_code"] = codes[len(train) :]
# Keep original string column for grouping
train[f27_col] = train[f27_col].astype(str)
test[f27_col] = test[f27_col].astype(str)

# ----------------------------- POLYNOMIAL FEATURES -----------------------------
print("Computing polynomial features...")
train_cont = train[continuous_cols].values
test_cont = test[continuous_cols].values
all_cont = np.vstack([train_cont, test_cont])

poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=False, interaction_only=False)
poly.fit(all_cont)
poly_train = poly.transform(train_cont)
poly_test = poly.transform(test_cont)
poly_feature_names = poly.get_feature_names_out(continuous_cols)
df_poly_train = pd.DataFrame(poly_train, columns=poly_feature_names)
df_poly_test = pd.DataFrame(poly_test, columns=poly_feature_names)


# ----------------------------- ENCODING HELPER -----------------------------
def add_encodings(train_df, test_df, y_train, alpha=10.0):
    """
    train_df : DataFrame with columns f27_col, cat_cols_low, continuous_cols
    test_df  : DataFrame with same columns (no target)
    y_train  : Series of target values aligned with train_df
    Returns (base_train, base_test, agg_col_names, global_fill_values)
    base_train/test contain the low-cardinality categoricals + new encodings.
    """
    # Work on copies to avoid mutating the original
    tr = train_df.copy()
    te = test_df.copy()

    # ---------- Frequency encoding for f_27 ----------
    freq_map = tr[f27_col].value_counts().to_dict()
    f27_freq_train = tr[f27_col].map(freq_map).fillna(0).values
    f27_freq_test = te[f27_col].map(freq_map).fillna(0).values

    # ---------- Smoothed target encoding for f_27 ----------
    global_mean = y_train.mean()
    agg = y_train.groupby(tr[f27_col]).agg(["sum", "count"])
    agg["enc"] = (agg["sum"] + global_mean * alpha) / (agg["count"] + alpha)
    enc_map = agg["enc"].to_dict()
    f27_te_train = tr[f27_col].map(enc_map).fillna(global_mean).values
    f27_te_test = te[f27_col].map(enc_map).fillna(global_mean).values

    # ---------- Group aggregations for low-cardinality categoricals ----------
    global_mean_cont = tr[continuous_cols].mean()
    global_std_cont = tr[continuous_cols].std()

    agg_cols_list = []  # to collect column names
    train_agg_parts = []  # to collect arrays for train
    test_agg_parts = []  # for test

    for cat in cat_cols_low:
        # Group by current categorical
        grp = tr.groupby(cat)[continuous_cols].agg(["mean", "std"])
        # Build flat column names
        new_col_names = []
        for col in continuous_cols:
            for stat in ["mean", "std"]:
                new_col_names.append(f"{cat}_{col}_{stat}")

        # Extract values as numpy arrays, replace NaNs with appropriate fill
        # grp is a DataFrame with index = category values, columns = MultiIndex
        stats_vals = grp.values  # shape (n_cats, 2*len(continuous_cols))
        cat_idx = grp.index.values  # category values

        # Map to train
        train_cat_vals = tr[cat].values  # shape (n_train,)
        # For each category, find row in grp or fill
        # Use dictionary to map quickly
        val_dict = {}
        for i, cat_val in enumerate(cat_idx):
            val_dict[cat_val] = stats_vals[i]

        # Prepare fill values for unseen categories: global means/stds
        fill = np.zeros(stats_vals.shape[1])
        for j, col in enumerate(continuous_cols):
            fill[j * 2] = global_mean_cont[col]  # mean
            fill[j * 2 + 1] = global_std_cont[col]  # std

        # Create arrays for train and test
        train_agg = np.array([val_dict.get(v, fill) for v in train_cat_vals])
        test_cat_vals = te[cat].values
        test_agg = np.array([val_dict.get(v, fill) for v in test_cat_vals])

        train_agg_parts.append(train_agg)
        test_agg_parts.append(test_agg)
        agg_cols_list.extend(new_col_names)

    # Combine all aggregations (horizontal stack)
    train_agg_all = np.hstack(train_agg_parts)  # shape (n_train, total_agg)
    test_agg_all = np.hstack(test_agg_parts)

    # ---------- Build final DataFrames ----------
    # Low-cardinality categoricals (as int, needed for LightGBM categorical)
    base_train = pd.DataFrame(
        tr[cat_cols_low].values.astype(np.int32), columns=cat_cols_low
    )
    base_test = pd.DataFrame(
        te[cat_cols_low].values.astype(np.int32), columns=cat_cols_low
    )

    # Add aggregations
    train_agg_df = pd.DataFrame(train_agg_all, columns=agg_cols_list)
    test_agg_df = pd.DataFrame(test_agg_all, columns=agg_cols_list)

    # Add f_27 encodings
    train_agg_df["f27_freq"] = f27_freq_train
    train_agg_df["f27_te"] = f27_te_train
    test_agg_df["f27_freq"] = f27_freq_test
    test_agg_df["f27_te"] = f27_te_test

    # Final base (cat_cols + agg + f27 features)
    base_train = pd.concat(
        [base_train.reset_index(drop=True), train_agg_df.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1
    )
    base_test = pd.concat(
        [base_test.reset_index(drop=True), test_agg_df.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1
    )

    return base_train, base_test, cat_cols_low  # returning cat_cols for later indexing


# ----------------------------- LIGHTGBM PARAMETERS -----------------------------
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 64,  # reduced from 128 to control model size
    "learning_rate": 0.02,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "lambda_l1": 0.2,
    "lambda_l2": 1.0,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 200,  # increased to reduce overfitting
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "max_cat_threshold": 64,  # low cardinality -> safe
}

callbacks = [lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)]

# ----------------------------- 5-FOLD CV -----------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
oof_preds = np.zeros(len(y_train_full))
best_iterations = []

# We'll need the original train data with columns: cat_cols_low + continuous_cols + f27_col + 'f27_code' (not used) + target
orig_train = pd.concat(
    [
        train[cat_cols_low + continuous_cols + [f27_col, "f27_code"]],
        pd.Series(y_train_full, name="target"),
    ],
    axis=1,
)

print("Starting 5-fold cross-validation...")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(orig_train, y_train_full)):
    # Split
    train_fold_df = orig_train.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
    val_fold_df = orig_train.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
    y_tr_fold = train_fold_df["target"].values
    y_val_fold = val_fold_df["target"].values

    # Prepare DataFrames for encoding (without target inside)
    train_enc_in = train_fold_df.drop(columns=["target", "f27_code"])
    val_enc_in = val_fold_df.drop(columns=["target", "f27_code"])

    # Generate encodings
    base_tr, base_val, cat_cols_names = add_encodings(
        train_enc_in, val_enc_in, pd.Series(y_tr_fold)
    )

    # Combine with polynomial features (align indices)
    poly_train_fold = df_poly_train.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
    poly_val_fold = df_poly_train.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

    X_tr = pd.concat([poly_train_fold, base_tr], axis=1)
    X_val = pd.concat([poly_val_fold, base_val], axis=1)

    # Categorical feature indices for LightGBM (cat_cols_low appear right after poly features)
    cat_features_idx = list(
        range(len(poly_feature_names), len(poly_feature_names) + len(cat_cols_low))
    )

    # Train LightGBM
    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr_fold, categorical_feature=cat_features_idx)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val_fold, categorical_feature=cat_features_idx)

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=800,
        valid_sets=[dtrain, dval],
        valid_names=["train", "valid"],
        callbacks=callbacks,
    )

    # Record best iteration
    best_iterations.append(model.best_iteration)

    # OOF predictions
    oof_preds[val_idx] = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

    # Print fold score
    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_fold, oof_preds[val_idx])
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {fold_auc:.6f}  best_iter: {model.best_iteration}")

# Overall CV score
cv_auc = roc_auc_score(y_train_full, oof_preds)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_auc:.6f}")

# ----------------------------- FINAL MODEL ON FULL DATA -----------------------------
# Prepare full training data for encoding
full_train_enc_in = train[cat_cols_low + continuous_cols + [f27_col]].copy()
full_test_enc_in = test[cat_cols_low + continuous_cols + [f27_col]].copy()

print("Generating final encodings on full dataset...")
base_train_full, base_test_full, _ = add_encodings(
    full_train_enc_in, full_test_enc_in, y_train_full
)

# Combine with polynomial features
X_train_final = pd.concat(
    [df_poly_train.reset_index(drop=True), base_train_full.reset_index(drop=True)],
    axis=1,
)
X_test_final = pd.concat(
    [df_poly_test.reset_index(drop=True), base_test_full.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1
)

# Average best number of rounds from CV
best_round = int(np.mean(best_iterations))
print(f"Final training with best_round = {best_round}")

cat_features_idx_final = list(
    range(len(poly_feature_names), len(poly_feature_names) + len(cat_cols_low))
)
dtrain_full = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_final, label=y_train_full, categorical_feature=cat_features_idx_final
)

model_final = lgb.train(
    params,
    dtrain_full,
    num_boost_round=best_round,
    valid_sets=[dtrain_full],  # no early stopping, just to log
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Predict on test
test_preds = model_final.predict(X_test_final, num_iteration=best_round)

# ----------------------------- SAVE SUBMISSION -----------------------------
sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": id_test, "target": test_preds})
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

    "f_28",
]

# 4. Polynomial features (degree 2) on continuous columns
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=False, interaction_only=False)
poly_all = np.vstack([X_train[cont_cols].values, X_test[cont_cols].values])
poly.fit(poly_all)
poly_train = poly.transform(X_train[cont_cols].values)
poly_test = poly.transform(X_test[cont_cols].values)
poly_feat_names = poly.get_feature_names_out(cont_cols)
df_poly_train = pd.DataFrame(poly_train, columns=poly_feat_names, index=X_train.index)
df_poly_test = pd.DataFrame(poly_test, columns=poly_feat_names, index=X_test.index)

# 5. Group statistics: mean & std of continuous features for each categorical column
global_mean = X_train[cont_cols].mean()
global_std = X_train[cont_cols].std()


def add_cat_group_stats(df, cat_col, cont_cols, train_ref, global_mean, global_std):
    """
    Compute mean/std of each continuous column per category in train_ref,
    then map these statistics onto df. Missing categories (in test) are
    filled with the global mean/std of the training set.
    """
    grouped = train_ref.groupby(cat_col)[cont_cols].agg(["mean", "std"])
    # flatten MultiIndex columns: f_07_f_00_mean, f_07_f_00_std, ...
    grouped.columns = [f"{cat_col}_{c[0]}_{c[1]}" for c in grouped.columns]

    df = df.merge(grouped, left_on=cat_col, right_index=True, how="left")

    # fill unseen categories with global stats
    for stat in ["mean", "std"]:
        for c in cont_cols:
            colname = f"{cat_col}_{c}_{stat}"
            fill_val = global_mean[c] if stat == "mean" else global_std[c]
            df[colname] = df[colname].fillna(fill_val)
    return df


# Apply to low-cardinality categoricals
X_train_fe = X_train.copy()
X_test_fe = X_test.copy()
for cat in cat_cols:
    X_train_fe = add_cat_group_stats(
        X_train_fe, cat, cont_cols, X_train, global_mean, global_std
    )
    X_test_fe = add_cat_group_stats(
        X_test_fe, cat, cont_cols, X_train, global_mean, global_std
    )

# Apply to high-cardinality f_27
X_train_fe = add_cat_group_stats(
    X_train_fe, "f_27", cont_cols, X_train, global_mean, global_std
)
X_test_fe = add_cat_group_stats(
    X_test_fe, "f_27", cont_cols, X_train, global_mean, global_std
)

# 6. Build final feature set:
new_cols = [c for c in X_train_fe.columns if c not in cont_cols + cat_cols + ["f_27"]]

X_train_processed = pd.concat(
    [df_poly_train, X_train_fe[cat_cols + ["f_27"] + new_cols]],
    axis=1,
)
X_test_processed = pd.concat(
    [df_poly_test, X_test_fe[cat_cols + ["f_27"] + new_cols]],
    axis=1,
)

# Convert to float32 for memory efficiency and GPU compatibility
X_train_processed = X_train_processed.astype(np.float32)
X_test_processed = X_test_processed.astype(np.float32)

# 7. Categorical feature indices for LightGBM (original low-cardinality columns)
cat_features_idx = [X_train_processed.columns.get_loc(c) for c in cat_cols]

# ----------------------------- LIGHTGBM SETUP -----------------------------
# *** FIX: Enable GPU training to avoid timeout ***
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 128,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.7,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.7,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "lambda_l1": 0.5,
    "lambda_l2": 5.0,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 200,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "device": "gpu",  # <-- ENABLED GPU
    "gpu_platform_id": 0,
    "gpu_device_id": 0,
}

callbacks = [
    lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50),
    lgb.log_evaluation(period=100),
]

# ----------------------------- 5-FOLD CV -----------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
oof_preds = np.zeros(len(y_train), dtype=np.float64)
test_preds = np.zeros(len(id_test), dtype=np.float64)

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train_processed, y_train)):
    print(f"--- Fold {fold+1} ---")
    X_tr = X_train_processed.iloc[tr_idx]
    X_val = X_train_processed.iloc[val_idx]
    y_tr = y_train.iloc[tr_idx]
    y_val = y_train.iloc[val_idx]

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_features_idx)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature=cat_features_idx)

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=500,
        valid_sets=[dtrain, dval],
        valid_names=["train", "valid"],
        callbacks=callbacks,
    )

    # Predict on validation and test
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    oof_preds[val_idx] = val_pred
    test_preds += (
        model.predict(X_test_processed, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
        / skf.n_splits
    )

# ----------------------------- EVALUATION -----------------------------
cv_auc = roc_auc_score(y_train, oof_preds)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_auc:.6f}")

# ----------------------------- SUBMISSION -----------------------------
sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": id_test, "target": test_preds})
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb

# ----------------------------- DATA LOADING -----------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

X_train = train.drop(columns=["id", "target"])
y_train = train["target"].values
id_test = test["id"]
X_test = test.drop(columns=["id"])

# ----------------------------- PREPROCESSING -----------------------------
# Factorize f_27
all_f27 = pd.concat([X_train["f_27"], X_test["f_27"]], axis=0).astype(str)
codes_f27, _ = pd.factorize(all_f27, sort=False)
X_train["f_27"] = codes_f27[: len(X_train)]
X_test["f_27"] = codes_f27[len(X_train) :]
f27_train = X_train["f_27"].values
f27_test = X_test["f_27"].values

# Categorical columns for LightGBM
cat_cols_lgb = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]
for c in cat_cols_lgb:
    X_train[c] = X_train[c].astype(int)
    X_test[c] = X_test[c].astype(int)

all_int_cols = cat_cols_lgb + ["f_27"]

# Continuous columns for polynomial expansion
numeric_cols = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]

numeric_train = X_train[numeric_cols].values
numeric_test = X_test[numeric_cols].values
numeric_all = np.vstack([numeric_train, numeric_test])
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=False, interaction_only=False)
poly.fit(numeric_all)
poly_train = poly.transform(numeric_train)
poly_test = poly.transform(numeric_test)
poly_feature_names = poly.get_feature_names_out(numeric_cols)

df_poly_train = pd.DataFrame(poly_train, columns=poly_feature_names)
df_poly_test = pd.DataFrame(poly_test, columns=poly_feature_names)


# ----------------------------- TARGET ENCODING HELPER -----------------------------
def get_target_encode_mapping(f27_codes, y_vals, smoothing=10):
    stats = (
        pd.DataFrame({"f27": f27_codes, "y": y_vals})
        .groupby("f27")
        .agg(n=("y", "count"), sum_y=("y", "sum"))
    )
    prior = np.mean(y_vals)
    stats["enc"] = (stats["sum_y"] + prior * smoothing) / (stats["n"] + smoothing)
    return stats["enc"].to_dict(), prior


# ----------------------------- 5-FOLD CV & STACKING -----------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

oof_lgb = np.zeros(len(y_train))
oof_xgb = np.zeros(len(y_train))
test_lgb = np.zeros(len(id_test))
test_xgb = np.zeros(len(id_test))

lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 128,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,  # increased to reduce rounds
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "lambda_l1": 0.1,
    "lambda_l2": 1.0,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 100,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "device": "cpu",
}

xgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "eval_metric": "auc",
    "tree_method": "hist",
    "learning_rate": 0.1,  # increased to reduce rounds
    "max_depth": 6,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 1.0,
    "min_child_weight": 5,
    "nthread": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
}

poly_train_arr = df_poly_train.values
poly_test_arr = df_poly_test.values
int_train_arr = X_train[all_int_cols].values
int_test_arr = X_test[all_int_cols].values

n_poly = poly_train_arr.shape[1]
cat_indices_lgb = [n_poly + i for i, c in enumerate(all_int_cols) if c in cat_cols_lgb]

# Fixed number of rounds for speed (no early‑stopping needed now)
LGB_ROUNDS = 300
XGB_ROUNDS = 200

print("Starting 5-fold cross-validation for stacking ensemble...")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y_train)):
    print(f"--- Fold {fold+1} ---")

    f27_tr = f27_train[train_idx]
    y_tr_enc = y_train[train_idx]
    f27_map, prior = get_target_encode_mapping(f27_tr, y_tr_enc, smoothing=10)

    f27_enc_train_fold = np.array([f27_map.get(c, prior) for c in f27_tr])
    f27_enc_val = np.array([f27_map.get(c, prior) for c in f27_train[val_idx]])
    f27_enc_test = np.array([f27_map.get(c, prior) for c in f27_test])

    X_tr = np.hstack(
        [
            poly_train_arr[train_idx],
            int_train_arr[train_idx],
            f27_enc_train_fold.reshape(-1, 1),
        ]
    )
    y_tr = y_train[train_idx]

    X_val = np.hstack(
        [poly_train_arr[val_idx], int_train_arr[val_idx], f27_enc_val.reshape(-1, 1)]
    )
    y_val = y_train[val_idx]

    X_test_feat = np.hstack([poly_test_arr, int_test_arr, f27_enc_test.reshape(-1, 1)])

    # LightGBM
    dtrain_lgb = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_indices_lgb)
    dval_lgb = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature=cat_indices_lgb)
    model_lgb = lgb.train(
        lgb_params,
        dtrain_lgb,
        num_boost_round=LGB_ROUNDS,
        valid_sets=[dval_lgb],
        valid_names=["valid"],
        callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )
    oof_lgb[val_idx] = model_lgb.predict(X_val)
    test_lgb += model_lgb.predict(X_test_feat) / skf.n_splits

    # XGBoost
    dtrain_xgb = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    dval_xgb = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val)
    model_xgb = xgb.train(
        xgb_params,
        dtrain_xgb,
        num_boost_round=XGB_ROUNDS,
        evals=[(dval_xgb, "valid")],
        verbose_eval=False,
    )
    oof_xgb[val_idx] = model_xgb.predict(dval_xgb)
    test_xgb += model_xgb.predict(xgb.DMatrix(X_test_feat)) / skf.n_splits

# ----------------------------- STACKING & OOF CV SCORE -----------------------------
stack_X = np.column_stack([oof_lgb, oof_xgb])
meta_model = LogisticRegression()
meta_model.fit(stack_X, y_train)
oof_stack_proba = meta_model.predict_proba(stack_X)[:, 1]
cv_auc = roc_auc_score(y_train, oof_stack_proba)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_auc:.6f}")

# ----------------------------- FINAL TRAINING & SUBMISSION -----------------------------
# Target encoding from the whole training set (no leakage because we don't use a holdout)
f27_map_full, prior_full = get_target_encode_mapping(f27_train, y_train, smoothing=10)
f27_enc_train_full = np.array([f27_map_full.get(c, prior_full) for c in f27_train])
f27_enc_test_full = np.array([f27_map_full.get(c, prior_full) for c in f27_test])

X_train_full = np.hstack(
    [poly_train_arr, int_train_arr, f27_enc_train_full.reshape(-1, 1)]
)
X_test_full = np.hstack([poly_test_arr, int_test_arr, f27_enc_test_full.reshape(-1, 1)])

# Train final LightGBM on full data using the same number of rounds
dtrain_full_lgb = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_full, label=y_train, categorical_feature=cat_indices_lgb
)
lgb_full = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    dtrain_full_lgb,
    num_boost_round=LGB_ROUNDS,
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)
test_pred_lgb = lgb_full.predict(X_test_full)

# Train final XGBoost on full data using the same number of rounds
dtrain_full_xgb = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_full, label=y_train)
xgb_full = xgb.train(
    xgb_params,
    dtrain_full_xgb,
    num_boost_round=XGB_ROUNDS,
    verbose_eval=False,
)
test_pred_xgb = xgb_full.predict(xgb.DMatrix(X_test_full))

# Stack and save submission
stack_test = np.column_stack([test_pred_lgb, test_pred_xgb])
final_test_proba = meta_model.predict_proba(stack_test)[:, 1]
sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": id_test, "target": final_test_proba})
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print("submission.csv saved.")

import os
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from lightgbm.callback import early_stopping, log_evaluation
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

DATA_DIR = "data"


def extract_geometry_features(filepath):
    """Parse an XYZ file and return a dict of structural descriptors."""
    with open(filepath, "r") as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    if not lines:
        return {}
    elements = []
    coords = []
    for line in lines[2:]:
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) >= 4:
            elements.append(parts[0])
            coords.append([float(x) for x in parts[1:4]])
    elements = np.array(elements)
    coords = np.array(coords)

    feat = {}
    # Atom counts
    unique, counts = np.unique(elements, return_counts=True)
    for elem, cnt in zip(unique, counts):
        feat[f"count_{elem}"] = cnt

    n = len(coords)
    if n <= 1:
        feat["dist_mean"] = 0.0
        feat["dist_std"] = 0.0
        feat["dist_min"] = 0.0
        feat["dist_max"] = 0.0
        feat["dist_median"] = 0.0
        for i in range(50):
            feat[f"hist_{i}"] = 0.0
        return feat

    # Pairwise distances
    diff = coords[:, np.newaxis, :] - coords[np.newaxis, :, :]  # (n, n, 3)
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum(diff**2, axis=-1))
    iu = np.triu_indices(n, k=1)
    distances = dist[iu]

    feat["dist_mean"] = float(np.mean(distances))
    feat["dist_std"] = float(np.std(distances))
    feat["dist_min"] = float(np.min(distances))
    feat["dist_max"] = float(np.max(distances))
    feat["dist_median"] = float(np.median(distances))

    # Histogram (probability distribution)
    hist, _ = np.histogram(distances, bins=50, range=(0.0, 15.0))
    total = hist.sum()
    if total > 0:
        hist = hist / total
    for i, val in enumerate(hist):
        feat[f"hist_{i}"] = float(val)
    return feat


def main():
    start = time.time()

    # ---- 1. Load tabular data ----
    train_csv = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
    test_csv = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv"))

    train_ids = train_csv["id"].values
    test_ids = test_csv["id"].values

    # ---- 2. Extract geometry features ----
    print("Extracting geometry features (train) ...")
    train_geom_feats = []
    for mid in train_ids:
        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train", str(mid), "geometry.xyz")
        feat = extract_geometry_features(fpath)
        feat["id"] = mid
        train_geom_feats.append(feat)
    train_geom_df = pd.DataFrame(train_geom_feats)

    print("Extracting geometry features (test) ...")
    test_geom_feats = []
    for mid in test_ids:
        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test", str(mid), "geometry.xyz")
        feat = extract_geometry_features(fpath)
        feat["id"] = mid
        test_geom_feats.append(feat)
    test_geom_df = pd.DataFrame(test_geom_feats)

    # ---- 3. Align geometry feature columns between train and test ----
    geom_cols = sorted(set(train_geom_df.columns) | set(test_geom_df.columns) - {"id"})
    for df in (train_geom_df, test_geom_df):
        for col in geom_cols:
            if col not in df.columns:
                df[col] = 0.0

    # Merge geometry features with original CSVs
    train_all = train_csv.merge(train_geom_df, on="id", how="left")
    test_all = test_csv.merge(test_geom_df, on="id", how="left")

    # ---- 4. Prepare features and targets ----
    target_cols = ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]
    exclude_cols = ["id"] + target_cols

    # Encode spacegroup safely
    codes, uniques = pd.factorize(train_all["spacegroup"])
    train_all["spacegroup"] = codes
    mapping = {val: i for i, val in enumerate(uniques)}
    test_all["spacegroup"] = test_all["spacegroup"].map(mapping).fillna(-1).astype(int)

    feature_cols = [c for c in train_all.columns if c not in exclude_cols]
    # Fill any remaining NaN (e.g., missing atom types or geometry features) with 0
    train_all[feature_cols] = train_all[feature_cols].fillna(0)
    test_all[feature_cols] = test_all[feature_cols].fillna(0)

    X = train_all[feature_cols].values
    y_form = train_all["formation_energy_ev_natom"].values
    y_bgap = train_all["bandgap_energy_ev"].values
    X_test = test_all[feature_cols].values

    # ---- 5. RMSLE metric ----
    def rmsle(y_true, y_pred):
        y_pred = np.clip(y_pred, -1 + 1e-6, None)  # keep log argument positive
        return np.sqrt(np.mean((np.log1p(y_true) - np.log1p(y_pred)) ** 2))

    # ---- 6. 5-fold CV with early stopping ----
    kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    fold_scores_form = []
    fold_scores_bgap = []
    fold_best_iter_form = []
    fold_best_iter_bgap = []

    for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X), 1):
        X_tr, X_val = X[tr_idx], X[val_idx]
        y_tr_form, y_val_form = y_form[tr_idx], y_form[val_idx]
        y_tr_bgap, y_val_bgap = y_bgap[tr_idx], y_bgap[val_idx]

        # Further split tr into train/early-stop
        X_tr_tr, X_tr_es, y_tr_tr_form, y_tr_es_form = train_test_split(
            X_tr, y_tr_form, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
        )
        X_tr_tr, X_tr_es, y_tr_tr_bgap, y_tr_es_bgap = train_test_split(
            X_tr, y_tr_bgap, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
        )

        params = {
            "objective": "regression",
            "metric": "rmse",
            "n_estimators": 1000,
            "learning_rate": 0.03,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "max_depth": -1,
            "random_state": 42,
            "n_jobs": -1,
            "verbosity": -1,
        }

        # Formation model
        model_f = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**params)
        model_f.fit(
            X_tr_tr,
            y_tr_tr_form,
            eval_set=[(X_tr_es, y_tr_es_form)],
            callbacks=[early_stopping(50), log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        y_val_pred_form = model_f.predict(X_val)
        score_f = rmsle(y_val_form, y_val_pred_form)
        fold_scores_form.append(score_f)
        fold_best_iter_form.append(model_f.best_iteration_)

        # Bandgap model
        model_b = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**params)
        model_b.fit(
            X_tr_tr,
            y_tr_tr_bgap,
            eval_set=[(X_tr_es, y_tr_es_bgap)],
            callbacks=[early_stopping(50), log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        y_val_pred_bgap = model_b.predict(X_val)
        score_b = rmsle(y_val_bgap, y_val_pred_bgap)
        fold_scores_bgap.append(score_b)
        fold_best_iter_bgap.append(model_b.best_iteration_)

        fold_avg = (score_f + score_b) / 2
        print(
            f"Fold {fold}: form RMSLE={score_f:.6f}, bgap RMSLE={score_b:.6f}, avg={fold_avg:.6f}"
        )

    avg_form = np.mean(fold_scores_form)
    avg_bgap = np.mean(fold_scores_bgap)
    avg_combined = (avg_form + avg_bgap) / 2
    print(f"\nCV mean  formation RMSLE: {avg_form:.6f}")
    print(f"CV mean  bandgap RMSLE: {avg_bgap:.6f}")
    print(f"CV mean  combined RMSLE: {avg_combined:.6f}")

    # ---- 7. Final models on full training data ----
    best_iter_form = int(np.round(np.mean(fold_best_iter_form)))
    best_iter_bgap = int(np.round(np.mean(fold_best_iter_bgap)))

    final_params_form = {
        "objective": "regression",
        "metric": "rmse",
        "n_estimators": best_iter_form,
        "learning_rate": 0.03,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "max_depth": -1,
        "random_state": 42,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "verbosity": -1,
    }
    final_params_bgap = dict(final_params_form)
    final_params_bgap["n_estimators"] = best_iter_bgap

    print("Training final formation model ...")
    final_m_f = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**final_params_form)
    final_m_f.fit(X, y_form)

    print("Training final bandgap model ...")
    final_m_b = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**final_params_bgap)
    final_m_b.fit(X, y_bgap)

    # ---- 8. Predict and save submission ----
    test_pred_form = final_m_f.predict(X_test)
    test_pred_bgap = final_m_b.predict(X_test)

    sub = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": test_ids,
            "formation_energy_ev_natom": test_pred_form,
            "bandgap_energy_ev": test_pred_bgap,
        }
    )
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to submission.csv")

    elapsed = time.time() - start
    print(f"Total runtime: {elapsed:.1f} seconds")
    print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {avg_combined:.6f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def detect_column_names(df):

        ):

    comp_cols = None
    for cands in candidates_comp:
        if all(c in df.columns for c in cands):
