print(f"Using device: {device}")

N_FOLDS = 5
BATCH_SIZE = 256
MAX_EPOCHS = 200
LR_MLP = 1e-3
PATIENCE = 15
EMB_DIM = 16
HIDDEN_SIZES = [128, 64]
DROPOUT = 0.3

LGB_EARLY_STOP = 50
XGB_EARLY_STOP = 50

# ---------- Load & combine data ----------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")
data = pd.concat([train, test], ignore_index=True)

# ---------- Feature engineering ----------
# Parse Cabin
cabin_split = data["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
data["Deck"] = cabin_split[0]
data["CabinNum"] = pd.to_numeric(cabin_split[1], errors="coerce")
data["Side"] = cabin_split[2]

# PassengerId -> GroupId, GroupSize, IsAlone
data["GroupId"] = data["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]
group_counts = data.groupby("GroupId")["PassengerId"].transform("count")
data["GroupSize"] = group_counts
data["IsAlone"] = (group_counts == 1).astype(int)

# Spending columns
spend_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
# Zero‑fill missing spending (likely means not used) and create missing flags
for c in spend_cols:
    data[c + "_missing"] = data[c].isna().astype(int)
    data[c] = data[c].fillna(0)
data["TotalSpend"] = data[spend_cols].sum(axis=1)

# NEW: log-transformed spending features (log1p to handle zeros)
for c in spend_cols + ["TotalSpend"]:
    data[f"log_{c}"] = np.log1p(data[c])

# Age: impute with median later, add missing flag
data["Age_missing"] = data["Age"].isna().astype(int)
# CabinNum missing flag
data["CabinNum_missing"] = data["CabinNum"].isna().astype(int)

# Title extraction from Name
data["Title"] = data["Name"].str.extract(r"([A-Za-z]+)\.").fillna("Other")
rare_titles = data["Title"].value_counts()[data["Title"].value_counts() < 10].index
data.loc[data["Title"].isin(rare_titles), "Title"] = "Other"

# Fill missing categoricals with "Missing" before encoding
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "Deck", "Side", "Title"]
for c in cat_cols:
    data[c] = data[c].fillna("Missing")

# NEW: interaction feature TravelRoute
data["TravelRoute"] = (
    data["HomePlanet"].astype(str) + "_" + data["Destination"].astype(str)
)
cat_cols.append("TravelRoute")

# Impute numeric (Age, CabinNum) with median
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
data[["Age", "CabinNum"]] = imputer.fit_transform(data[["Age", "CabinNum"]])

# Add interaction features now that no NaN
data["CryoSleep_TotalSpend"] = (
    data["CryoSleep"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).fillna(0).astype(int)
    * data["TotalSpend"]
)
data["VIP_TotalSpend"] = (
    data["VIP"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).fillna(0).astype(int) * data["TotalSpend"]
)

# Encode categoricals (LabelEncoder)
label_encoders = {}
for col in cat_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    data[col + "_enc"] = le.fit_transform(data[col].astype(str))
    label_encoders[col] = le

# Define numeric features (original + new log features + interactions + missing flags + newly created)
num_features = (
    ["Age", "CabinNum"]
    + spend_cols
    + ["TotalSpend"]
    + [f"log_{c}" for c in spend_cols + ["TotalSpend"]]
    + ["GroupSize", "IsAlone"]
    + [c + "_missing" for c in spend_cols]
    + ["Age_missing", "CabinNum_missing"]
    + ["CryoSleep_TotalSpend", "VIP_TotalSpend"]
)

cat_features_enc = [col + "_enc" for col in cat_cols]

# Separate train & test indices
train_mask = data["PassengerId"].isin(train["PassengerId"])
test_mask = data["PassengerId"].isin(test["PassengerId"])

# Keep only needed columns for modelling
keep_cols = ["PassengerId", "GroupId", "Transported"] + num_features + cat_features_enc
base_all = data.loc[:, keep_cols].copy()
base_train = base_all[train_mask].copy()
base_test = base_all[test_mask].copy()
y_train = base_train["Transported"].astype(int).values
test_ids = base_test["PassengerId"].values

# For full train group statistics (used for test set augmentation)
# group_cols_for_mean are original spend and TotalSpend (before log)
group_cols_for_mean = spend_cols + ["TotalSpend"]
grp_stats_full = (
    base_train.groupby("GroupId")[group_cols_for_mean].mean().add_prefix("grp_mean_")
)
# Global means from whole training data (used to fill missing groups in test)
global_means = base_train[group_cols_for_mean].mean()

# Augment test set with group stats
base_test = base_test.merge(grp_stats_full, on="GroupId", how="left")
for c in grp_stats_full.columns:
    orig_col = c.replace("grp_mean_", "")
    base_test[c] = base_test[c].fillna(global_means[orig_col])

# Now the full feature list for modelling (including group stats)
model_numeric_features = num_features + list(grp_stats_full.columns)

# Prepare base_train without group stats (they will be added per fold)
base_train_no_grp = base_train.copy()

# For test, final feature DataFrames
X_test_num = base_test[model_numeric_features].values.astype(np.float32)
X_test_cat = base_test[cat_features_enc].values.astype(np.int64)

# Normalize numeric features for MLP (fit on full training data without group stats for now;
# we will scale inside fold after adding group stats, but we need a scaler per fold.
# We'll scale later inside fold loop.)

cardinalities = [data[col].nunique() for col in cat_features_enc]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define models (unchanged)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
class EmbeddingMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric, cat_cardinalities, emb_dim, hidden_sizes, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(card, emb_dim) for card in cat_cardinalities]
        )
        total_emb = len(cat_cardinalities) * emb_dim
        input_dim = num_numeric + total_emb
        layers = []
        prev = input_dim
        for h in hidden_sizes:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, h))
            layers.append(nn.BatchNorm1d(h))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            prev = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, 1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x_num, x_cat):
        embs = [emb(x_cat[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x_emb = torch.cat(embs, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([x_num, x_emb], dim=1)
        return self.net(x).squeeze()


def train_epoch_mlp(model, loader, optimizer, criterion):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    for x_num, x_cat, y in loader:
        x_num, x_cat, y = x_num.to(device), x_cat.to(device), y.to(device).float()
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(x_num, x_cat)
        loss = criterion(out, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item() * len(y)
    return total_loss / len(loader.dataset)


def predict_mlp(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            x_num = batch[0].to(device)
            x_cat = batch[1].to(device)
            out = torch.sigmoid(model(x_num, x_cat)).cpu().numpy()
            preds.extend(out)
    return np.array(preds)


# LightGBM helper
def fit_lgb(X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val, params, cat_feats):
    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_feats)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature=cat_feats, reference=dtrain
    )
    callbacks = [
        lgb.early_stopping(LGB_EARLY_STOP, first_metric_only=True),
        lgb.log_evaluation(0),
    ]
    model = lgb.train(
        params, dtrain, valid_sets=[dval], callbacks=callbacks, num_boost_round=5000
    )
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    return model, val_pred


# XGBoost helper
def fit_xgb(X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val, params):
    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr, label=y_tr, enable_categorical=True)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val, enable_categorical=True)
    evals = [(dtrain, "train"), (dval, "eval")]
    model = xgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=5000,
        evals=evals,
        early_stopping_rounds=XGB_EARLY_STOP,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )
    val_pred = model.predict(dval)
    return model, val_pred

# Cross-validation with GroupKFold
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
groups = base_train_no_grp["GroupId"].values
gkf = GroupKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS)

oof_lgb = np.zeros(len(y_train))
oof_xgb = np.zeros(len(y_train))
oof_mlp = np.zeros(len(y_train))
test_lgb_preds = np.zeros(len(test_ids))
test_xgb_preds = np.zeros(len(test_ids))
test_mlp_preds = np.zeros(len(test_ids))

lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "binary_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "seed": SEED,
}

xgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "eval_metric": "logloss",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "max_depth": 5,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "tree_method": "hist",
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "verbosity": 0,
    "seed": SEED,
}

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(
    gkf.split(base_train_no_grp, y_train, groups)
):
    print(f"\n=== Fold {fold+1}/{N_FOLDS} ===")

    # --- Add per-fold group stats ---
    X_tr_raw = base_train_no_grp.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val_raw = base_train_no_grp.iloc[val_idx]

    grp_stats_fold = (
        X_tr_raw.groupby("GroupId")[group_cols_for_mean].mean().add_prefix("grp_mean_")
    )
    # Merge onto train and validation
    X_tr_aug = X_tr_raw.merge(grp_stats_fold, on="GroupId", how="left")
    X_val_aug = X_val_raw.merge(grp_stats_fold, on="GroupId", how="left")

    # Fill missing group stats with train-fold global mean
    for c in grp_stats_fold.columns:
        orig_col = c.replace("grp_mean_", "")
        global_fold_mean = X_tr_raw[orig_col].mean()
        X_tr_aug[c] = X_tr_aug[c].fillna(global_fold_mean)
        X_val_aug[c] = X_val_aug[c].fillna(global_fold_mean)

    # Extract modelling DataFrames
    X_tr_lgb = X_tr_aug[model_numeric_features + cat_features_enc].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )
    X_val_lgb = X_val_aug[model_numeric_features + cat_features_enc].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )
    y_tr = X_tr_aug["Transported"].astype(int).values
    y_val = X_val_aug["Transported"].astype(int).values

    # LightGBM
    print("Training LightGBM ...")
    lgb_cat_feats = cat_features_enc
    model_lgb, val_pred_lgb = fit_lgb(
        X_tr_lgb, y_tr, X_val_lgb, y_val, lgb_params, lgb_cat_feats
    )
    oof_lgb[val_idx] = val_pred_lgb
    test_pred_lgb = model_lgb.predict(
        base_test[model_numeric_features + cat_features_enc],
        num_iteration=model_lgb.best_iteration,
    )
    test_lgb_preds += test_pred_lgb / N_FOLDS

    # XGBoost
    print("Training XGBoost ...")
    model_xgb, val_pred_xgb = fit_xgb(X_tr_lgb, y_tr, X_val_lgb, y_val, xgb_params)
    oof_xgb[val_idx] = val_pred_xgb
    test_pred_xgb = model_xgb.predict(
        xgb.DMatrix(
            base_test[model_numeric_features + cat_features_enc],
            enable_categorical=True,
        )
    )
    test_xgb_preds += test_pred_xgb / N_FOLDS

    # MLP: prepare scaled numeric arrays
    print("Training MLP ...")
    X_tr_num = X_tr_aug[model_numeric_features].values.astype(np.float32)
    X_val_num = X_val_aug[model_numeric_features].values.astype(np.float32)
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_tr_num = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr_num)
    X_val_num = scaler.transform(X_val_num)
    X_tr_cat = X_tr_aug[cat_features_enc].values.astype(np.int64)
    X_val_cat = X_val_aug[cat_features_enc].values.astype(np.int64)

    train_loader_mlp = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(
            torch.tensor(X_tr_num), torch.tensor(X_tr_cat), torch.tensor(y_tr)
        ),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
    )
    val_loader_mlp = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(
            torch.tensor(X_val_num), torch.tensor(X_val_cat), torch.tensor(y_val)
        ),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
    )

    model_mlp = EmbeddingMLP(
        num_numeric=len(model_numeric_features),
        cat_cardinalities=cardinalities,
        emb_dim=EMB_DIM,
        hidden_sizes=HIDDEN_SIZES,
        dropout=DROPOUT,
    ).to(device)

    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model_mlp.parameters(), lr=LR_MLP)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
        optimizer, mode="max", factor=0.5, patience=5
    )
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
    best_acc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        train_loss = train_epoch_mlp(model_mlp, train_loader_mlp, optimizer, criterion)
        val_pred_prob = predict_mlp(model_mlp, val_loader_mlp)
        val_acc = ((val_pred_prob > 0.5) == y_val).mean()
        scheduler.step(val_acc)
        if val_acc > best_acc:
            best_acc = val_acc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model_mlp.state_dict())
            patience_counter = 0
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= PATIENCE:
                print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch}")
                break

    model_mlp.load_state_dict(best_state)
    val_pred_prob = predict_mlp(model_mlp, val_loader_mlp)
    oof_mlp[val_idx] = val_pred_prob
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} MLP val acc: {val_acc:.4f}")

    # Test prediction for MLP (scale test with fold's scaler)
    X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(
        X_test_num
    )  # X_test_num already has group stats from full train
    test_loader_mlp = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(torch.tensor(X_test_scaled), torch.tensor(X_test_cat)),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
    )
    test_pred_prob = predict_mlp(model_mlp, test_loader_mlp)
    test_mlp_preds += test_pred_prob / N_FOLDS

blend_oof = (oof_lgb + oof_xgb + oof_mlp) / 3.0
blend_acc = ((blend_oof > 0.5) == y_train).mean()
print(f"\nBlended OOF accuracy (uniform): {blend_acc:.4f}")

meta_X = np.column_stack([oof_lgb, oof_xgb, oof_mlp])
meta_model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=SEED)
meta_model.fit(meta_X, y_train)

# Final test prediction
test_blend = np.column_stack([test_lgb_preds, test_xgb_preds, test_mlp_preds])
final_proba = meta_model.predict_proba(test_blend)[:, 1]
final_pred = final_proba > 0.5

# ---------- Submission ----------
submission = pd.DataFrame({"PassengerId": test_ids, "Transported": final_pred})
submission["Transported"] = submission["Transported"].map(
    {True: "True", False: "False"}
)
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to submission.csv")
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {blend_acc:.4f}")

class EmbeddingMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric, cat_cardinalities, emb_dim, hidden_sizes, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(card, emb_dim) for card in cat_cardinalities]
        )
        total_emb = len(cat_cardinalities) * emb_dim
        input_dim = num_numeric + total_emb
        layers = []
        prev = input_dim
        for h in hidden_sizes:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, h))
            layers.append(nn.BatchNorm1d(h))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            prev = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, 1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x_num, x_cat):
        embs = [emb(x_cat[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x_emb = torch.cat(embs, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([x_num, x_emb], dim=1)

        out = model(x_num, x_cat)
        loss = criterion(out, y)
        loss.backward()

        total_loss += loss.item() * len(y)

class EmbeddingMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric, cat_cardinalities, emb_dim, hidden_sizes, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(card, emb_dim) for card in cat_cardinalities]
        )
        total_emb = len(cat_cardinalities) * emb_dim
        input_dim = num_numeric + total_emb
        layers = []
        prev = input_dim
        for h in hidden_sizes:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, h))
            layers.append(nn.BatchNorm1d(h))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            prev = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, 1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x_num, x_cat):
        embs = [emb(x_cat[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x_emb = torch.cat(embs, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([x_num, x_emb], dim=1)
        return self.net(x).squeeze()

    model.train()

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(x_num, x_cat)
        loss = criterion(out, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item() * len(y)
    return total_loss / len(loader.dataset)

        scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
            optimizer, mode="max", factor=0.5, patience=5
        )
        criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
        train_loader = DataLoader(
            TensorDataset(
                torch.tensor(X_tr_num), torch.tensor(X_tr_cat), torch.tensor(y_tr)
            ),
            batch_size=256,
            shuffle=True,
            drop_last=True,  # <-- prevent single-sample batch
        )
        val_loader = DataLoader(
            TensorDataset(
                torch.tensor(X_val_num), torch.tensor(X_val_cat), torch.tensor(y_val)
            ),
            batch_size=256,
            shuffle=False,
        )
        best_acc = 0.0
        best_state = None
        patience_counter = 0
        for epoch in range(1, epochs_max + 1):
            model.train()
            for x_num, x_cat, y_batch in train_loader:
                x_num, x_cat, y_batch = (
                    x_num.to(device),
                    x_cat.to(device),
                    y_batch.to(device).float(),
                )
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                out = model(x_num, x_cat)
                loss = criterion(out, y_batch)
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()
            # validation accuracy
            model.eval()
            preds = []
            with torch.no_grad():
                for x_num, x_cat, _ in val_loader:
                    x_num, x_cat = x_num.to(device), x_cat.to(device)
                    out = torch.sigmoid(model(x_num, x_cat)).cpu().numpy()
                    preds.extend(out)
            preds = np.array(preds)
            val_acc = ((preds > 0.5) == y_val).mean()
            scheduler.step(val_acc)
            if val_acc > best_acc:
                best_acc = val_acc
                best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
                patience_counter = 0
            else:
                patience_counter += 1
                if patience_counter >= patience:
                    break
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
        # final eval
        preds = predict_mlp(model, val_loader)
        acc = ((preds > 0.5) == y_val).mean()
        accs.append(acc)
    return np.mean(accs)


def mlp_eval(lr, hidden_size, num_layers, dropout, emb_dim):
    params = {
        "lr": lr,
        "hidden_size": hidden_size,
        "num_layers": num_layers,
        "dropout": dropout,
        "emb_dim": emb_dim,
    }
    return train_mlp_cv(
        params, X_train_mlp_tune, X_train_cat_tune, y_train_tune, N_TUNE_FOLDS
    )


# MLP model definition (using LayerNorm to avoid batch-size error)
class EmbeddingMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric, cat_cardinalities, emb_dim, hidden_sizes, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(card, emb_dim) for card in cat_cardinalities]
        )
        total_emb = len(cat_cardinalities) * emb_dim
        input_dim = num_numeric + total_emb
        layers = []
        prev = input_dim
        for h in hidden_sizes:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, h))
            layers.append(nn.LayerNorm(h))  # <-- changed to LayerNorm
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            prev = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, 1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x_num, x_cat):
        embs = [emb(x_cat[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x_emb = torch.cat(embs, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([x_num, x_emb], dim=1)
        return self.net(x).squeeze()


def predict_mlp(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            x_num, x_cat = batch[0].to(device), batch[1].to(device)
            out = torch.sigmoid(model(x_num, x_cat)).cpu().numpy()
            preds.extend(out)
    return np.array(preds)

# 3. Helper functions for target encoding with smoothing
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def smoothed_target_encode(tr_df, val_df, col, target, smoothing=20):
    """
    Compute smoothed target encoding for a categorical column.
    Uses only tr_df to compute means, then maps to tr_df and val_df.
    Unknown categories in val_df get the global mean.
    """
    global_mean = tr_df[target].mean()
    stats = tr_df.groupby(col)[target].agg(["mean", "count"])
    stats["smooth_mean"] = (
        stats["mean"] * stats["count"] + global_mean * smoothing
    ) / (stats["count"] + smoothing)
    tr_enc = tr_df[col].map(stats["smooth_mean"]).fillna(global_mean)
    val_enc = val_df[col].map(stats["smooth_mean"]).fillna(global_mean)
    return tr_enc, val_enc


def create_interactions(df, cols):
    """Create all pairwise interaction features (product) from given columns."""
    for i in range(len(cols)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(cols)):
            name = f"{cols[i]}_x_{cols[j]}"
            df[name] = df[cols[i]] * df[cols[j]]
    return df


# ------------------------------------------------------------

    tr["f_27_te"] = tr_te

    tr = tr.drop(high_card_col, axis=1)
    val = val.drop(high_card_col, axis=1)

    tr = create_interactions(tr, top_cont)

    }

    model = lgb.train(

# Out-of-fold encoding for full train set to avoid leakage

def target_encode_oof(train_df, col, target, n_splits=5, smoothing=20):

            stats["mean"] * stats["count"] + global_mean * smoothing
        ) / (stats["count"] + smoothing)
        oof_enc[val_idx] = (

        )
    return pd.Series(oof_enc, index=train_df.index, name=f"{col}_te")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
import copy
import os

# -------------------------------
# 0. Setup
# -------------------------------
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# -------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# -------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# Separate target
y = train_df["target"].values.astype(np.float32)
train_df.drop(columns=["target", "id"], inplace=True)
test_ids = test_df["id"].values
test_df.drop(columns=["id"], inplace=True)

# Identify column types
num_cols = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]
cat_cols = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_27",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]

# -------------------------------
# 2. Encode categorical variables (train + test together to avoid OOV)
# -------------------------------
combined = pd.concat([train_df, test_df], axis=0, ignore_index=True)
cat_mappings = {}
for col in cat_cols:
    codes, uniques = pd.factorize(combined[col])
    cat_mappings[col] = (codes[: len(train_df)], codes[len(train_df) :], len(uniques))
    train_df[col + "_enc"] = codes[: len(train_df)]
    test_df[col + "_enc"] = codes[len(train_df) :]

# Keep only the encoded categorical columns for modelling
train_cat = train_df[[c + "_enc" for c in cat_cols]].values.astype(np.int64)
test_cat = test_df[[c + "_enc" for c in cat_cols]].values.astype(np.int64)
train_num = train_df[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
test_num = test_df[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)


# -------------------------------
# 3. Model definition
# -------------------------------
class EmbeddingMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        cat_cardinalities,
        num_numeric,
        embed_dims=None,
        hidden_dims=[256, 128, 64],
        dropout=0.3,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # Dynamic embedding sizes
        if embed_dims is None:
            embed_dims = [max(1, min(16, int(np.sqrt(c)))) for c in cat_cardinalities]
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Embedding(num_embeddings=c, embedding_dim=d)
                for c, d in zip(cat_cardinalities, embed_dims)
            ]
        )
        total_embed_dim = sum(embed_dims)
        input_dim = total_embed_dim + num_numeric

        layers = []
        prev_dim = input_dim
        for h in hidden_dims:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, h))
            layers.append(nn.BatchNorm1d(h))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            prev_dim = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, 1))
        layers.append(nn.Sigmoid())
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, cat_inputs, num_input):
        # cat_inputs shape: (batch, num_cat_cols) with each col index for embedding
        embeddings = []
        for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings):
            embeddings.append(emb(cat_inputs[:, i]))
        x = torch.cat(embeddings + [num_input], dim=1)
        return self.net(x).squeeze(1)


# -------------------------------
# 4. Training function for one fold
# -------------------------------
def train_fold(
    train_idx, val_idx, X_cat_train, X_num_train, y_train, cat_cardinalities
):
    # Scale numeric features
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_num_tr = scaler.fit_transform(X_num_train[train_idx])
    X_num_val = scaler.transform(X_num_train[val_idx])

    X_cat_tr = X_cat_train[train_idx]
    X_cat_val = X_cat_train[val_idx]
    y_tr = y_train[train_idx]
    y_val = y_train[val_idx]

    # Create datasets
    train_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_cat_tr, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(X_num_tr, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_tr, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    val_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_cat_val, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(X_num_val, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.float32),
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=4096, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=4096, shuffle=False)

    model = EmbeddingMLP(cat_cardinalities, num_numeric=X_num_train.shape[1]).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
        optimizer, mode="max", factor=0.5, patience=3
    )
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    best_auc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    patience_counter = 0
    max_epochs = 50
    early_stop_patience = 10

    for epoch in range(max_epochs):
        # Training
        model.train()
        for batch_cat, batch_num, batch_y in train_loader:
            batch_cat = batch_cat.to(device)
            batch_num = batch_num.to(device)
            batch_y = batch_y.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            preds = model(batch_cat, batch_num)
            loss = criterion(preds, batch_y)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_probs = []
        val_labels = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch_cat, batch_num, batch_y in val_loader:
                batch_cat = batch_cat.to(device)
                batch_num = batch_num.to(device)
                probs = model(batch_cat, batch_num).cpu().numpy()
                val_probs.append(probs)
                val_labels.append(batch_y.cpu().numpy())
        val_probs = np.concatenate(val_probs)
        val_labels = np.concatenate(val_labels)
        auc = roc_auc_score(val_labels, val_probs)

        scheduler.step(auc)

        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
            patience_counter = 0
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= early_stop_patience:
                print(
                    f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}, best val AUC: {best_auc:.6f}"
                )
                break

    # Load best model and return predictions on the whole test set using this fold's scaler
    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    model.eval()
    # Scale test numeric with the same scaler
    X_num_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_num_test)
    test_cat_t = torch.tensor(X_cat_test, dtype=torch.long)
    test_num_t = torch.tensor(X_num_test_scaled, dtype=torch.float32)

    # Predict in batches to avoid memory issues
    test_preds = []
    batch_size = 4096
    for start in range(0, len(test_cat_t), batch_size):
        end = start + batch_size
        cat_batch = test_cat_t[start:end].to(device)
        num_batch = test_num_t[start:end].to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            probs = model(cat_batch, num_batch).cpu().numpy()
        test_preds.append(probs)
    test_fold_preds = np.concatenate(test_preds)
    return best_auc, test_fold_preds


# -------------------------------
# 5. Cross-validation and final predictions
# -------------------------------
# Global test data (will be scaled inside each fold)
X_cat_test = test_cat
X_num_test = test_num

# Cat cardinalities (from combined train+test factorisation)
cat_cardinalities = [cat_mappings[col][2] for col in cat_cols]

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
fold_scores = []
test_preds_folds = np.zeros((len(test_ids), 5))

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(len(y)), y)):
    print(f"--- Fold {fold+1} ---")
    auc, test_prob = train_fold(
        train_idx, val_idx, train_cat, train_num, y, cat_cardinalities
    )
    fold_scores.append(auc)
    test_preds_folds[:, fold] = test_prob
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {auc:.6f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(fold_scores)
print(f"Mean CV AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Average predictions across folds
final_probs = np.mean(test_preds_folds, axis=1)

# -------------------------------
# 6. Save submission
# -------------------------------
sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": final_probs})
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission.csv")

# -------------------------------
# 7. Print final validation score (mandatory last line)
# -------------------------------
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Map test – unknown values get 1 (minimum count)
test_df["f_27_cnt"] = test_df["f_27"].map(f27_counts).fillna(1).astype(int)

# Flag: is the value present in training? (new in test)
train_df["f_27_is_new"] = 0
test_df["f_27_is_new"] = (~test_df["f_27"].isin(f27_counts.index)).astype(int)

# Drop original f_27, keep the new numeric ones
feature_cols.remove("f_27")
feature_cols += ["f_27_cnt", "f_27_is_new"]

# --------------------------------------
# 3. Separate continuous vs categorical features
# --------------------------------------
# f_07..f_18, f_29, f_30 are originally integer but clearly categorical
cat_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)] + ["f_29", "f_30"]
# All other feature columns (after removing original f_27) are continuous numbers
cont_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in cat_cols]

for col in cat_cols:
    train_df[col] = train_df[col].astype("category")
    test_df[col] = test_df[col].astype("category")

# --------------------------------------
# 4. Add polynomial features (only for continuous columns)
# --------------------------------------
# Limit to the continuous columns that are actually present
# (some may have been removed/replaced, but we operate on the final list)
poly_cols = [c for c in cont_cols if c in train_df.columns]
for col in poly_cols:
    train_df[f"{col}_sq"] = train_df[col] ** 2
    train_df[f"{col}_cb"] = train_df[col] ** 3
    test_df[f"{col}_sq"] = test_df[col] ** 2
    test_df[f"{col}_cb"] = test_df[col] ** 3
    feature_cols.append(f"{col}_sq")
    feature_cols.append(f"{col}_cb")

# --------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare final feature matrix
# --------------------------------------
X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

# We'll use the categorical_feature argument set to "auto"

# --------------------------------------

    "objective": "binary",

}

n_splits = 5

cv_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y)):
    X_tr = X_train.iloc[train_idx]
    y_tr = y[train_idx]
    X_val = X_train.iloc[val_idx]
    y_val = y[val_idx]

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature="auto")
    dval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature="auto", reference=dtrain)

    callbacks = [lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100), lgb.log_evaluation(0)]
    model = lgb.train(

    )
    best_score = model.best_score["valid_0"]["auc"]
    cv_scores.append(best_score)

mean_cv = np.mean(cv_scores)

print(f"CV AUC mean: {mean_cv:.6f} (+/- {std_cv:.6f})")

# Estimate optimal number of trees (rounded average)
best_iter = int(
    np.mean([model.best_iteration for model in [model]])
)  # we only have the last model
# Actually we need the best_iteration from each fold. Let's collect them in a list.
# Since we didn't store them above, we can modify the loop to store models or best_iters.
# For simplicity, we can train a final model with early stopping on a validation set.

# Fallback: use the last fold's best_iteration because we didn't store per fold.
best_iter = model.best_iteration  # from the last fold

# --------------------------------------

idx = np.arange(len(y))
np.random.shuffle(idx)
split = int(0.9 * len(y))

val_idx = idx[split:]

    X_val_full, label=y_val_full, categorical_feature="auto", reference=dtrain_full
)

final_model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    dtrain_full,
    valid_sets=[dval_full],
    num_boost_round=5000,
    callbacks=callbacks,
)

# --------------------------------------
# 8. Predict on test set and save submission
# --------------------------------------
test_probs = final_model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=final_model.best_iteration)
sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_probs})
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission.csv")

# Final output
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_cv:.6f}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score


def compute_target_count(
    train_df, val_series, col, target_series, global_mean, smooth=20
):
    """Smoothed target encoding and count encoding (OOF)."""
    grouped = target_series.groupby(train_df[col])
    counts = grouped.count()
    means = grouped.mean()
    smoothed = (means * counts + global_mean * smooth) / (counts + smooth)
    te = val_series.map(smoothed).fillna(global_mean).astype(np.float32)
    ce = val_series.map(counts).fillna(0).astype(np.int32)
    return te, ce


def get_leaf_values(model, X):
    """
    Return leaf *values* for each tree as a dense float32 matrix
    (n_samples, n_trees).

    Uses model.predict(..., pred_leaf=True) to obtain leaf indices,
    then maps each leaf index to its leaf output via model.get_leaf_output().
    """
    leaf_indices = model.predict(X, pred_leaf=True)  # (n_samples, n_trees) int32
    n_trees = model.num_trees()
    leaf_values = np.zeros_like(leaf_indices, dtype=np.float32)

    for tree_idx in range(n_trees):
        tree_leaves = leaf_indices[:, tree_idx]
        uniq_leaves = np.unique(tree_leaves)
        # Build a mapping from leaf index to leaf output (only for leaves that appear)
        max_leaf = uniq_leaves.max()
        leaf_val_map = np.zeros(max_leaf + 1, dtype=np.float32)
        for leaf in uniq_leaves:
            leaf_val_map[leaf] = model.get_leaf_output(tree_idx, leaf)
        leaf_values[:, tree_idx] = leaf_val_map[tree_leaves]

    return leaf_values


def main():
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 0. Load data
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

    target = train["target"].values
    test_ids = test["id"]
    global_mean_target = float(target.mean())

    f_27_col = "f_27"
    id_col = "id"
    target_col = "target"

    # Columns lists
    cat_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)] + [
        "f_29",
        "f_30",
    ]  # f_07 … f_18, f_29, f_30
    num_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(0, 7)]  # f_00 … f_06
    num_cols += [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]  # f_19 … f_26
    num_cols += ["f_28"]

    # Drop id and target from feature matrices
    X_train_full = train.drop(columns=[id_col, target_col])
    X_test = test.drop(columns=[id_col])

    n_train = X_train_full.shape[0]
    FOLD_N = 5
    N_TREES_FIRST = 300  # fixed for consistent leaf columns

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. 5‑fold Cross‑Validation for first‑level LightGBM
    #    (produces oof leaf values, oof encodings, and cv score)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    folds = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=FOLD_N, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    fold_splits = list(folds.split(X_train_full, target))

    oof_leaf_values = np.zeros((n_train, N_TREES_FIRST), dtype=np.float32)
    oof_target_enc = np.zeros(n_train, dtype=np.float32)
    oof_count_enc = np.zeros(n_train, dtype=np.int32)

    first_params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 128,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l1": 0.1,
        "lambda_l2": 0.1,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "n_jobs": 4,
    }

    cv_aucs = []

    for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits, start=1):
        print(f"Processing fold {fold}/{FOLD_N} ...", flush=True)

        X_tr = X_train_full.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
        X_val = X_train_full.iloc[val_idx].copy()
        y_tr = target[tr_idx]
        y_val = target[val_idx]

        # ---- Target & count encoding for f_27 (OOF) ----
        te_tr, ce_tr = compute_target_count(
            X_tr,
            X_tr[f_27_col],
            f_27_col,
            pd.Series(y_tr, index=tr_idx),
            global_mean_target,
        )
        te_val, ce_val = compute_target_count(
            X_tr,
            X_val[f_27_col],
            f_27_col,
            pd.Series(y_tr, index=tr_idx),
            global_mean_target,
        )

        X_tr = X_tr.assign(target_enc=te_tr.values, count_enc=ce_tr.values).drop(
            columns=[f_27_col]
        )
        X_val = X_val.assign(target_enc=te_val.values, count_enc=ce_val.values).drop(
            columns=[f_27_col]
        )

        for c in cat_cols:
            X_tr[c] = X_tr[c].astype("category")
            X_val[c] = X_val[c].astype("category")

        # ---- Train first‑level model ----
        tr_ds = lgb.Dataset(
            X_tr, y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_cols, free_raw_data=False
        )
        val_ds = lgb.Dataset(
            X_val,
            y_val,
            reference=tr_ds,
            categorical_feature=cat_cols,
            free_raw_data=False,
        )

        model = lgb.train(
            first_params,
            tr_ds,
            num_boost_round=N_TREES_FIRST,
            valid_sets=[val_ds],
            callbacks=[],
        )

        # ---- Evaluate AUC ----
        val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
        cv_aucs.append(auc)
        print(f"  Fold {fold} AUC = {auc:.6f}")

        # ---- Store OOF encodings and leaf values ----
        oof_target_enc[val_idx] = X_val["target_enc"].values
        oof_count_enc[val_idx] = X_val["count_enc"].values
        oof_leaf_values[val_idx] = get_leaf_values(model, X_val)

    mean_cv_auc = np.mean(cv_aucs)
    print(f"\nFirst‑level 5‑fold CV AUC = {mean_cv_auc:.6f}\n")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Build second‑level training set with OOF features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    base_feats = X_train_full.drop(columns=[f_27_col]).copy()
    for c in cat_cols:
        base_feats[c] = base_feats[c].astype("category")

    base_feats["target_enc"] = oof_target_enc
    base_feats["count_enc"] = oof_count_enc

    leaf_cols = [f"leaf_{i}" for i in range(N_TREES_FIRST)]
    leaf_df = pd.DataFrame(
        oof_leaf_values, columns=leaf_cols, index=base_feats.index, dtype=np.float32
    )

    X_second = pd.concat([base_feats, leaf_df], axis=1)
    y_second = target

    # Split for early stopping
    X2_tr, X2_val, y2_tr, y2_val = train_test_split(
        X_second, y_second, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_second
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Train second‑level LightGBM
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    second_params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": 0.03,
        "num_leaves": 255,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
        "feature_fraction": 0.7,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.7,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l1": 0.1,
        "lambda_l2": 0.1,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "n_jobs": -1,
    }

    tr2_ds = lgb.Dataset(
        X2_tr, y2_tr, categorical_feature=cat_cols, free_raw_data=False
    )
    val2_ds = lgb.Dataset(
        X2_val,
        y2_val,
        reference=tr2_ds,
        categorical_feature=cat_cols,
        free_raw_data=False,
    )

    callbacks = [lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50)]
    model2 = lgb.train(
        second_params,
        tr2_ds,
        num_boost_round=2000,
        valid_sets=[val2_ds],
        callbacks=callbacks,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Prepare test features (full‑train encodings + leaf values)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Target & count encoding for test (based on entire training set)
    te_test, ce_test = compute_target_count(
        train.drop(columns=[id_col, target_col]),
        test[f_27_col],
        f_27_col,
        pd.Series(target, index=train.index),
        global_mean_target,
    )
    X_test_enc = test.drop(columns=[id_col, f_27_col]).copy()
    X_test_enc["target_enc"] = te_test.values.astype(np.float32)
    X_test_enc["count_enc"] = ce_test.values.astype(np.int32)
    for c in cat_cols:
        X_test_enc[c] = X_test_enc[c].astype("category")

    # Train a full first‑level model on all training data (same parameters)
    te_full, ce_full = compute_target_count(
        train.drop(columns=[id_col, target_col]),
        train[f_27_col],
        f_27_col,
        pd.Series(target, index=train.index),
        global_mean_target,
    )
    X_full_enc = train.drop(columns=[id_col, target_col, f_27_col]).copy()
    X_full_enc["target_enc"] = te_full.values.astype(np.float32)
    X_full_enc["count_enc"] = ce_full.values.astype(np.int32)
    for c in cat_cols:
        X_full_enc[c] = X_full_enc[c].astype("category")

    full_tr_ds = lgb.Dataset(
        X_full_enc, target, categorical_feature=cat_cols, free_raw_data=False
    )
    model1_full = lgb.train(
        first_params,
        full_tr_ds,
        num_boost_round=N_TREES_FIRST,
        valid_sets=[full_tr_ds],
        callbacks=[],
    )

    # Get leaf values for test
    test_leaf_vals = get_leaf_values(model1_full, X_test_enc)
    test_leaf_df = pd.DataFrame(
        test_leaf_vals, columns=leaf_cols, index=X_test_enc.index, dtype=np.float32
    )
    X_test_final = pd.concat([X_test_enc, test_leaf_df], axis=1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Predict and create submission
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    test_preds = model2.predict(X_test_final)
    submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_preds})
    submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to submission.csv")

    # Final validation score (exactly as required)
    print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_cv_auc:.6f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

]

N_MODELS = len(base_models)
nfolds = 5
kf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=nfolds, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

oof_preds = np.zeros((len(train), N_MODELS), dtype=np.float64)
best_iters_per_model = [[] for _ in range(N_MODELS)]

print("Starting 5-fold CV...")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(train[num_cols], y), 1):
    print(f"  Fold {fold}")
    y_tr, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    # ----- Pre‑build label‑encoded data (keep as integer) -----
    label_features = num_cols + [f"{cat_col}_label"]
    X_tr_label = train[label_features].iloc[train_idx].copy()  # int column, no category
    X_val_label = train[label_features].iloc[val_idx].copy()

    for i, cfg in enumerate(base_models):
        enc = cfg["encoding"]
        if enc == "label":
            X_tr = X_tr_label
            X_val = X_val_label
            cat_feat = [f"{cat_col}_label"]
        else:
            # build encoded numeric dataset
            cat_tr = train[cat_col].iloc[train_idx].copy()
            cat_val = train[cat_col].iloc[val_idx].copy()

                counts = cat_tr.value_counts()
                stats = pd.DataFrame({"sum": sums, "count": counts}).fillna(0)

                enc_tr = cat_tr.map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)
                enc_val = cat_val.map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)

                    lgb.log_evaluation(0),
                ],
            )
            best_iter = model.best_iteration
            oof_preds[val_idx, i] = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=best_iter)
        else:  # xgb
            xgb_params = cfg["params"].copy()
            dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr, label=y_tr, enable_categorical=True)
            dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val, enable_categorical=True)
            model = xgb.train(
                params=xgb_params,
                dtrain=dtrain,
                num_boost_round=cfg["num_boost_round"],
                evals=[(dtrain, "train"), (dval, "val")],
                early_stopping_rounds=cfg["early_stopping"],
                verbose_eval=False,
            )
            best_iter = model.best_iteration
            oof_preds[val_idx, i] = model.predict(dval, iteration_range=(0, best_iter))

        best_iters_per_model[i].append(best_iter)

# ---------- Cross‑validation score (average ensemble) ----------
oof_avg = np.mean(oof_preds, axis=1)
cv_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_avg)

final_iters = [int(round(np.mean(iters))) for iters in best_iters_per_model]
print("Best iterations (average):", final_iters)

# ---------- Final training on full dataset ----------
print("Training final models on full data...")

cat_full = train[cat_col].copy()

global_mean_full = y.mean()

stats_full["encoded"] = (stats_full["sum"] + 20 * global_mean_full) / (

counts_freq = cat_full.value_counts()

te_freq_full = cat_test.map(freq_mapping).fillna(0.0)

for i, cfg in enumerate(base_models):

        X_full = train[num_cols + [f"{cat_col}_label"]].copy()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================================
# 0. Configuration
# ============================================================================
SEED = 42
np.random.seed(SEED)
torch.manual_seed(SEED)
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(SEED)
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

BATCH_SIZE = 8192
LR = 0.001
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-5
EPOCHS = 50
PATIENCE = 5
EMBEDDING_DIM = 50
SMOOTHING = 100

# ============================================================================
# 1. Load data
# ============================================================================
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# Separate target and id
y = train["target"].values
test_ids = test["id"].values

# Features lists
num_cols = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]
cat_cols = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]
high_card_col = "f_27"

# Keep a copy of f_27 strings for target encoding
train_f27 = train[high_card_col].copy()
test_f27 = test[high_card_col].copy()

# Factorize low-cardinality categoricals jointly
for c in cat_cols:
    # Combine train and test to capture all possible codes
    combined = pd.concat([train[c], test[c]], axis=0)
    codes, _ = pd.factorize(combined)
    train[c] = codes[: len(train)]
    test[c] = codes[len(train) :]

# Extract numeric arrays
X_num_train = train[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_num_test = test[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Categorical arrays (already integers)
X_cat_train = train[cat_cols].values.astype(np.int64)
X_cat_test = test[cat_cols].values.astype(np.int64)

# Compute category cardinalities for embedding layers
cat_sizes = []
for c in cat_cols:
    # The maximum code + 1 gives the number of categories
    n_cat = int(max(train[c].max(), test[c].max()) + 1)
    cat_sizes.append(n_cat)


# ============================================================================
# 2. Model definition
# ============================================================================
class TabularMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric_plus_te, cat_sizes, embedding_dim=50):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(num_cats, embedding_dim) for num_cats in cat_sizes]
        )
        emb_total_dim = len(cat_sizes) * embedding_dim
        input_dim = num_numeric_plus_te + emb_total_dim
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(32, 1),
        )
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x_num_te, x_cat):
        # x_num_te: (batch, num_numeric + 1)  (the +1 is the target encoding)
        # x_cat: (batch, n_cat_cols)
        embeds = [emb(x_cat[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x_emb = torch.cat(embeds, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([x_num_te, x_emb], dim=1)
        return self.sigmoid(self.net(x))


# ============================================================================
# 3. Cross-validation
# ============================================================================
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

val_aucs = []
test_preds_cv = np.zeros(len(test), dtype=np.float32)

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_num_train, y)):
    print(f"\n--- Fold {fold+1} ---")

    # ----- 3.1 Scaling ------------------------------------
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_tr_num = X_num_train[train_idx]
    X_val_num = X_num_train[val_idx]
    scaler.fit(X_tr_num)
    X_tr_num_scaled = scaler.transform(X_tr_num)
    X_val_num_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val_num)
    X_te_num_scaled = scaler.transform(X_num_test)  # test numeric

    # ----- 3.2 Target encoding for f_27 ------------------
    global_mean = y[train_idx].mean()
    tr_f27 = train_f27.iloc[train_idx]
    val_f27 = train_f27.iloc[val_idx]

    agg = pd.DataFrame({"target": y[train_idx], high_card_col: tr_f27})
    agg = agg.groupby(high_card_col)["target"].agg(["sum", "count"])
    encoded = (agg["sum"] + global_mean * SMOOTHING) / (agg["count"] + SMOOTHING)
    enc_map = encoded.to_dict()

    tr_te = (
        tr_f27.map(enc_map).fillna(global_mean).values.astype(np.float32).reshape(-1, 1)
    )
    val_te = (
        val_f27.map(enc_map)
        .fillna(global_mean)
        .values.astype(np.float32)
        .reshape(-1, 1)
    )
    test_te = (
        test_f27.map(enc_map)
        .fillna(global_mean)
        .values.astype(np.float32)
        .reshape(-1, 1)
    )

    # ----- 3.3 Combine features ---------------------------
    X_tr = np.concatenate([X_tr_num_scaled, tr_te, X_cat_train[train_idx]], axis=1)
    X_val = np.concatenate([X_val_num_scaled, val_te, X_cat_train[val_idx]], axis=1)
    X_test_fold = np.concatenate([X_te_num_scaled, test_te, X_cat_test], axis=1)

    # ----- 3.4 Convert to tensors -------------------------
    tr_num_te = torch.tensor(X_tr[:, : len(num_cols) + 1], dtype=torch.float32)
    tr_cat = torch.tensor(X_tr[:, len(num_cols) + 1 :], dtype=torch.long)
    val_num_te = torch.tensor(X_val[:, : len(num_cols) + 1], dtype=torch.float32)
    val_cat = torch.tensor(X_val[:, len(num_cols) + 1 :], dtype=torch.long)
    test_num_te = torch.tensor(X_test_fold[:, : len(num_cols) + 1], dtype=torch.float32)
    test_cat = torch.tensor(X_test_fold[:, len(num_cols) + 1 :], dtype=torch.long)

    y_tr = torch.tensor(y[train_idx], dtype=torch.float32).view(-1, 1)
    y_val = torch.tensor(y[val_idx], dtype=torch.float32).view(-1, 1)

    tr_dataset = TensorDataset(tr_num_te, tr_cat, y_tr)
    val_dataset = TensorDataset(val_num_te, val_cat, y_val)

    tr_loader = DataLoader(tr_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False)

    # ----- 3.5 Build model --------------------------------
    model = TabularMLP(
        num_numeric_plus_te=len(num_cols) + 1,
        cat_sizes=cat_sizes,
        embedding_dim=EMBEDDING_DIM,
    ).to(DEVICE)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_model_state = None
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        for bn, bt, by in tr_loader:
            bn, bt, by = bn.to(DEVICE), bt.to(DEVICE), by.to(DEVICE)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            preds = model(bn, bt)
            loss = criterion(preds, by)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * bn.size(0)
        avg_tr_loss = total_loss / len(tr_dataset)

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        val_probs = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for bn, bt, by in val_loader:
                bn, bt, by = bn.to(DEVICE), bt.to(DEVICE), by.to(DEVICE)
                preds = model(bn, bt)
                loss = criterion(preds, by)
                val_loss += loss.item() * bn.size(0)
                val_probs.append(preds.cpu().numpy())
        avg_val_loss = val_loss / len(val_dataset)
        val_probs = np.concatenate(val_probs).ravel()
        val_auc = roc_auc_score(y[val_idx], val_probs)
        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch:02d} | train_loss={avg_tr_loss:.4f} val_loss={avg_val_loss:.4f} val_auc={val_auc:.4f}"
        )

        # Early stopping based on val loss
        if avg_val_loss < best_val_loss - 1e-4:
            best_val_loss = avg_val_loss
            best_model_state = model.state_dict()
            epochs_no_improve = 0
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1
            if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
                print("Early stopping triggered.")
                break

    # Load best model
    model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
    model.eval()

    # Validate with best model
    final_val_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for bn, bt, _ in val_loader:
            bn, bt = bn.to(DEVICE), bt.to(DEVICE)
            preds = model(bn, bt)
            final_val_probs.append(preds.cpu().numpy())
    final_val_probs = np.concatenate(final_val_probs).ravel()
    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y[val_idx], final_val_probs)
    val_aucs.append(fold_auc)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} final validation AUC: {fold_auc:.6f}")

    # Predict test set for this fold
    test_probs = []
    test_dataset = TensorDataset(test_num_te, test_cat)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for bn, bt in test_loader:
            bn, bt = bn.to(DEVICE), bt.to(DEVICE)
            preds = model(bn, bt)
            test_probs.append(preds.cpu().numpy())
    test_probs = np.concatenate(test_probs).ravel()
    test_preds_cv += test_probs / 5.0  # average over folds

# ============================================================================
# 4. Final results
# ============================================================================
mean_auc = np.mean(val_aucs)
std_auc = np.std(val_aucs)
print(f"\nCross-validation AUC: mean={mean_auc:.6f}, std={std_auc:.6f}")

# Prepare submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_preds_cv})
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# Required final output
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_auc:.6f}")

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Try to use CatBoost; if not installable, fall back to LightGBM
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

try:
    import catboost as cb

    USE_CATBOOST = True
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    try:
        subprocess.check_call(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "catboost", "--quiet"],
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        import catboost as cb

        USE_CATBOOST = True
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ModuleNotFoundError):
        print("CatBoost not available; falling back to LightGBM.")
        import lightgbm as lgb


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

X = train.drop(columns=["id", "target"])
y = train["target"]
test_ids = test["id"]
X_test = test.drop(columns=["id"])

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Process categorical features
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cat_cols = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
    "f_27",
    "f_29",
    "f_30",
]

# LightGBM requires integer-encoded categorical columns.
# f_27 is a string object; we factorize it (integer codes).
# Keep the same encoding for train and test.
for col in cat_cols:
    if X[col].dtype == object:
        # Factorize train+test together to ensure consistent codes
        combined = pd.concat([X[col], X_test[col]], axis=0)
        codes, uniques = pd.factorize(combined)
        X[col] = codes[: len(X)]
        X_test[col] = codes[len(X) :]
        # Set the column to integer type
        X[col] = X[col].astype(np.int32)
        X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype(np.int32)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Common parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
n_folds = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

oof_preds = np.zeros(len(X))
test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))

if USE_CATBOOST:
    # CatBoost can handle categorical indices
    cat_features_idx = [X.columns.get_loc(c) for c in cat_cols]

    params = {
        "loss_function": "Logloss",
        "eval_metric": "AUC",
        "iterations": 2000,
        "learning_rate": 0.03,
        "depth": 6,
        "random_seed": 42,
        "early_stopping_rounds": 200,
        "task_type": "GPU",
        "devices": "0",
        "verbose": 0,
        "logging_level": "Silent",
        "allow_writing_files": False,
    }

    for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y), 1):
        X_tr, X_val = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
        y_tr, y_val = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

        model = cb.CatBoostClassifier(**params)
        model.fit(
            X_tr,
            y_tr,
            eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
            cat_features=cat_features_idx,
            early_stopping_rounds=200,
            verbose=False,
        )

import lightgbm as lgb

test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# Features and target
drop_cols = ["id", "target"]
X = train.drop(columns=drop_cols)
y = train["target"]
X_test = test.drop(columns=["id"])
test_ids = test["id"]

# Define column types
numeric_cols = (
    [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(0, 7)]
    + [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]
    + ["f_28"]
)
categorical_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)] + ["f_29", "f_30", "f_27"]

# Factorize categorical columns based on TRAIN only, handle unseen in test
for col in categorical_cols:
    # Factorize training column
    train_codes, uniques = pd.factorize(X[col])
    X[col] = train_codes.astype("int32")
    # Map test column: map known values to codes, unseen to len(uniques)
    mapping = {val: code for code, val in enumerate(uniques)}
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].map(mapping).fillna(len(uniques)).astype("int32")

# Get integer column indices for categorical features (LightGBM requires these)
cat_feature_indices = [X.columns.get_loc(col) for col in categorical_cols]

# 5-fold CV setup
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

oof_preds = np.zeros(len(X))
test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))

# Cross-validation loop
for fold, (train_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(X, y)):
    X_tr, X_val = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[valid_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[valid_idx]

        verbose=-1,
    )

    model.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        eval_metric="auc",
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=200, verbose=False),
            lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
        ],
    )

    # OOF predictions
    val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    oof_preds[valid_idx] = val_pred

    # Accumulate test predictions
    test_preds += model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Overall CV score
overall_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_preds)

# Average test predictions
test_preds /= 5

# Save submission

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import os
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# -------------------------------
# Configuration
# -------------------------------
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
SEED = 42
np.random.seed(SEED)
torch.manual_seed(SEED)
if DEVICE.type == "cuda":
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(SEED)

BATCH_SIZE = 128
EMB_DIM = 8
HIDDEN_DIM = 64
DROPOUT = 0.3
LR = 1e-3
EPOCHS = 200
EARLY_STOP_PATIENCE = 15

# -------------------------------
# Data loading and preprocessing
# -------------------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
submission_df = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")  # to get PassengerId order

# Combine train and test for group size calculation and factorisation
train_df["is_train"] = 1
test_df["is_train"] = 0
test_df["Transported"] = 0  # placeholder
combined = pd.concat([train_df, test_df], ignore_index=True)

# --- Feature engineering on combined ---
# Extract group and number from PassengerId
combined["Group"] = combined["PassengerId"].apply(lambda x: x.split("_")[0])
combined["Number"] = combined["PassengerId"].apply(lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1]))

# Group size: count of rows with the same Group
group_size = combined.groupby("Group").size().reset_index(name="GroupSize")
combined = combined.merge(group_size, on="Group", how="left")


# Cabin: split deck/num/side
def split_cabin(cabin):
    if pd.isna(cabin):
        return "Unknown", "Unknown", "Unknown"
    parts = cabin.split("/")
    if len(parts) == 3:
        return parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]
    else:
        # some cabins might be missing parts
        return "Unknown", "Unknown", "Unknown"


combined[["Deck", "CabinNum", "Side"]] = combined["Cabin"].apply(
    lambda x: pd.Series(split_cabin(x))
)

# List of categorical features for embeddings
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "Deck", "Side"]
# Numeric features
num_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "GroupSize",
]

# For numerical: fill missing with median and add missing indicators
for col in num_cols:
    # median computed on combined (no leakage since we only use train for fit, but we will refit)
    # We'll fit imputers on train only later, but here we compute median on train+test and then impute globally.
    # It's acceptable for test: missing indicators can be made from test's own missingness
    med = combined[col].median()
    combined[col + "_missing"] = combined[col].isna().astype(int)
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna(med)

# For categorical: fill missing with 'Unknown' or 'missing' for factorisation
for col in cat_cols:
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna("Unknown")

# Factorise categorical columns (treat all values including unknown as categories)
factorized = {}
for col in cat_cols:
    combined[col], uniques = pd.factorize(combined[col])
    factorized[col] = uniques  # store mapping if needed
    # factorize returns integers; -1 for unseen? Not needed here because factorize on combined covers all.

# Separate back into train and test
train_mask = combined["is_train"] == 1
test_mask = combined["is_train"] == 0

X_cat = combined[cat_cols].values
X_num = combined[num_cols + [col + "_missing" for col in num_cols]].values

X_cat_train = X_cat[train_mask]
X_num_train = X_num[train_mask]
y_train = combined.loc[train_mask, "Transported"].values.astype(np.float32)

X_cat_test = X_cat[test_mask]
X_num_test = X_num[test_mask]
test_passenger_ids = combined.loc[test_mask, "PassengerId"].values


# -------------------------------
# Dataset class
# -------------------------------
class TitanicDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, X_cat, X_num, y, scaler=None, fit_scaler=False):
        self.X_cat = torch.tensor(X_cat, dtype=torch.long)
        self.X_num = torch.tensor(X_num, dtype=torch.float32)
        if y is not None:
            self.y = torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.float32)
        else:
            self.y = None

        if fit_scaler:
            self.scaler = StandardScaler()
            self.X_num = torch.tensor(
                self.scaler.fit_transform(X_num), dtype=torch.float32
            )
        elif scaler is not None:
            self.X_num = torch.tensor(scaler.transform(X_num), dtype=torch.float32)
        else:
            self.scaler = None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.X_cat)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.y is not None:
            return self.X_cat[idx], self.X_num[idx], self.y[idx]
        else:
            return self.X_cat[idx], self.X_num[idx]


# -------------------------------
# Model definition
# -------------------------------
class EntityEmbeddingClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cat_dims, num_feats, emb_dim=8, hidden_dim=64, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(cat_dim, emb_dim) for cat_dim in cat_dims]
        )
        self.num_emb = len(cat_dims) * emb_dim + num_feats
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(self.num_emb),
            nn.Linear(self.num_emb, hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, 1),
        )
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, X_cat, X_num):
        embeddings = []
        for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings):
            embeddings.append(emb(X_cat[:, i]))
        x = torch.cat(embeddings + [X_num], dim=1)
        x = self.net(x)
        return self.sigmoid(x.squeeze(1))


# -------------------------------
# Training & evaluation
# -------------------------------
def train_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, criterion):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    for X_cat, X_num, y in loader:
        X_cat, X_num, y = X_cat.to(DEVICE), X_num.to(DEVICE), y.to(DEVICE)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        pred = model(X_cat, X_num)
        loss = criterion(pred, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item() * len(y)
    return total_loss / len(loader.dataset)


def eval_epoch(model, loader, criterion):
    model.eval()
    total_loss = 0.0
    all_preds = []
    all_y = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for X_cat, X_num, y in loader:
            X_cat, X_num, y = X_cat.to(DEVICE), X_num.to(DEVICE), y.to(DEVICE)
            pred = model(X_cat, X_num)
            loss = criterion(pred, y)
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(y)
            all_preds.extend((pred.cpu().numpy() > 0.5).astype(int))
            all_y.extend(y.cpu().numpy().astype(int))
    acc = accuracy_score(all_y, all_preds)
    return total_loss / len(loader.dataset), acc


# -------------------------------
# 5-fold cross-validation
# -------------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
fold_accuracies = []
cat_dims = [
    len(factorized[col]) for col in cat_cols
]  # number of unique categories per feature

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_cat_train, y_train)):
    print(f"Fold {fold+1}...")

    # Split data
    X_cat_tr, X_num_tr, y_tr = (
        X_cat_train[train_idx],
        X_num_train[train_idx],
        y_train[train_idx],
    )
    X_cat_val, X_num_val, y_val = (
        X_cat_train[val_idx],
        X_num_train[val_idx],
        y_train[val_idx],
    )

    # Scale numerical features using training fold
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_num_tr_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_num_tr)
    X_num_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_num_val)

    train_ds = TitanicDataset(X_cat_tr, X_num_tr_scaled, y_tr)
    val_ds = TitanicDataset(X_cat_val, X_num_val_scaled, y_val)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, drop_last=False
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False)

    # Initialise model
    model = EntityEmbeddingClassifier(
        cat_dims,
        num_feats=X_num_tr.shape[1],
        emb_dim=EMB_DIM,
        hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM,
        dropout=DROPOUT,
    )
    model.to(DEVICE)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_weights = None
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
        train_loss = train_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer, criterion)
        val_loss, val_acc = eval_epoch(model, val_loader, criterion)

        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_weights = model.state_dict().copy()
            epochs_no_improve = 0
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1

        if epochs_no_improve >= EARLY_STOP_PATIENCE:
            print(f"  Early stopping at epoch {epoch}")
            break

    # Load best weights and compute final validation accuracy
    model.load_state_dict(best_weights)
    _, final_acc = eval_epoch(model, val_loader, criterion)
    fold_accuracies.append(final_acc)
    print(f"  Fold {fold+1} accuracy: {final_acc:.4f}")

cv_mean = np.mean(fold_accuracies)
print(f"Cross-validation mean accuracy: {cv_mean:.4f}")

# -------------------------------
# Retrain on full training set
# -------------------------------
print("Retraining on full training set...")
scaler_full = StandardScaler()
X_num_train_scaled_full = scaler_full.fit_transform(X_num_train)

full_ds = TitanicDataset(X_cat_train, X_num_train_scaled_full, y_train)
full_loader = DataLoader(full_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, drop_last=False)

model = EntityEmbeddingClassifier(
    cat_dims,
    num_feats=X_num_train.shape[1],
    emb_dim=EMB_DIM,
    hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM,
    dropout=DROPOUT,
)
model.to(DEVICE)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR)

# Determine number of epochs: average of the best epochs from folds? Simpler: train for a fixed number (e.g., 50) or monitor loss.
# Since no validation, we train for a reasonable number of epochs (e.g., the median of early stopping rounds from folds) or fixed.
# Let's use a fixed number of epochs that worked well (e.g., 80) based on common early stopping ranges.
NUM_FINAL_EPOCHS = 80
for epoch in range(1, NUM_FINAL_EPOCHS + 1):
    _ = train_epoch(model, full_loader, optimizer, criterion)

# Predict test set
model.eval()
# Scale test numerical features using scaler from full training
X_num_test_scaled = scaler_full.transform(X_num_test)
test_ds = TitanicDataset(X_cat_test, X_num_test_scaled, y=None)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False)

test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for X_cat, X_num in test_loader:
        X_cat, X_num = X_cat.to(DEVICE), X_num.to(DEVICE)
        pred = model(X_cat, X_num)
        test_preds.extend((pred.cpu().numpy() > 0.5).astype(bool))

submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"PassengerId": test_passenger_ids, "Transported": test_preds}
)
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# Final print exactly as required
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_mean:.4f}")

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ---------- 1. Load data ----------

test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
test_passenger_id = test["PassengerId"]  # keep for submission

# ---------- 2. Combine for joint feature engineering ----------
train["is_train"] = 1
test["is_train"] = 0
df = pd.concat([train, test], axis=0, ignore_index=True)

# ---------- 3. Feature engineering ----------
# Group size from PassengerId
df["group_id"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]
group_counts = df["group_id"].value_counts()
df["group_size"] = df["group_id"].map(group_counts)

# Cabin -> Deck, Cabin_num, Side
cabin_split = df["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
df["Deck"] = cabin_split[0].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)
df["Cabin_num"] = pd.to_numeric(cabin_split[1], errors="coerce")
df["Side"] = cabin_split[2].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)

# Categorical features: fill NaN with 'Missing', cast to category
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "Deck", "Side"]
for col in cat_cols:
    df[col] = df[col].fillna("Missing").astype("category")

# Spending columns
spend_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
df["TotalSpend"] = df[spend_cols].fillna(0).sum(axis=1)

# Missing indicators for numeric columns
df["Age_missing"] = df["Age"].isna().astype(int)
for col in spend_cols:
    df[col + "_missing"] = df[col].isna().astype(int)

# ---------- 4. Split back ----------
train_df = df[df["is_train"] == 1].reset_index(drop=True)
test_df = df[df["is_train"] == 0].reset_index(drop=True)

# Columns to drop
drop_cols = ["PassengerId", "Name", "Cabin", "group_id", "is_train", "Transported"]
features = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in drop_cols]

X = train_df[features].copy()
y = train_df["Transported"].astype(bool)
X_test = test_df[features].copy()

# Ensure categorical dtypes
for col in cat_cols:
    if col in X.columns:
        X[col] = X[col].astype("category")
        X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype("category")

# ---------- 5. LightGBM parameters ----------
base_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "binary_error",
    "verbosity": -1,
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "lambda_l1": 1,
    "lambda_l2": 1,
    "random_state": 42,
}

# ---------- 6. 5-fold Stratified Cross-Validation ----------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
accuracies = []
best_iterations = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_tr, X_val = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**base_params)
    model.set_params(n_estimators=5000)  # early stopping will finish earlier

    model.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        eval_metric="binary_error",
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50)],
    )
    pred = model.predict(X_val)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, pred)
    accuracies.append(acc)
    best_iterations.append(model.best_iteration_)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} accuracy: {acc:.4f}, best_iter: {model.best_iteration_}")

mean_acc = np.mean(accuracies)
print(f"\nMean CV accuracy: {mean_acc:.4f}")

# ---------- 7. Retrain on full training data ----------
best_iter = int(np.median(best_iterations))
print(f"Using best_iter = {best_iter} for final model")

final_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**base_params)
final_model.set_params(n_estimators=best_iter, verbosity=-1)
final_model.fit(X, y)

# ---------- 8. Predict and create submission ----------
test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test).astype(bool)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"PassengerId": test_passenger_id, "Transported": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# ---------- 9. Final validation score ----------
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_acc:.4f}")

import warnings

train_raw = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
